Mishneh Torah, Agents and Partners 10: Shuttaf shettaan al chavero shekkach haya tenay benehem vehalla omer lo haya tenay ze meolam. o shettaan shehakkeren shelli haya kach vechach vehalla omer eno ella pachot mizze. o shettaan shekkevar natatti lecha hashshuttafut vehalla omer lo lakachti. o shessechora zo mishshelli vehalla omer mishshel emtza vechol kayyotze bitanot ellu harshut beyad hattovea bishvua. ketzad. im ratza hattovea shello yishshava hashuttaf shevuat hashshuttafin veyashbio hesset al hattaana shekkofer bah veomer lo hayu devarim meolam hare ze mashbio. veim ratza megalgel alav kol ellu haddevarim bishvuat hashshuttafin umashbio betaanat safek shello gazalta kelum kol yeme hashshuttafut veshehaya benenu tenay kach veshezzo hassechora shellecha veshennatatta li kach vechach. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Hattovea shuttafo lehashebio shevuat hashshuttafin hannitba omer kevar chalaknu velo nishar lecha etzli kelum vehattovea omer adayin lo chalaknu velo asinu cheshbon. o sheamar hattovea chalaknu al menat sheashbia otcha shevuat hashshuttafin bechol et sheertze vaadayin lo nishbata veatta madche oti miyyom leyom. eno yachol lehashebio betaanat safek. afillu amar hannitba ken chalaknu venishar lecha etzli veze hannishar eno ella chov shezzekafattu alay o pikkadon hinnachta etzli af al pi sheyyesh edim shehaya shuttafo eno yachol lehashebio betaanat safek veeno yachol lehashebia hesset shekkevar chalku o shello nishtattefu meolam vaafillu al yede gilgul lefi sheen mashbiin hesset veen megalgelin ella im taano davar sheim yode bo yihye chayyav leshallem mamon. aval davar sheafillu hoda bo eno chayyav ella shevua eno nishba alav vaafillu al yede gilgul vechaze horu haggeonim baale horaa:

Taan sheadayin shuttafi atta venishar li etzlecha kach vechach veze omer kevar chalaknu velo nishar lecha etzli kelum o lo hayita shuttafi meolam hare hannitba nishba hesset sheen lo beyado kelum umegalgel alav shello gezaltani kelum meolam. veeno megalgel alav shello hayu shuttafo o shekkevar chalaknu min hattaam shebbearnu:

Taan sheadayin shuttafin anachnu veyesh li lehashebiacha betaanat safek vehalla omer lo nishtattafnu meolam vehevi hattovea edim shehaya shuttafo vechazar hannitba achar kach veamar chalaknu en shomin lo shehare huchzak kafran lishvua zo veyishshava shevuat hashshuttafin. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Reuven shehetil lechis arba meot dinarim vehetil shimon matayim venishtattefu venasu venatnu beyachad vahare hammamon kullo beyad reuven vetaan reuven sheppachat min hakkeren chamesh meot dinarin en omrim yishshava reuven shevuat hashshuttafin sheppachatu kach vishallem shimon chamishshim mibbeto ella yishshava reuven shevuat hashshuttafin sheppachatu veyelech bammane shebbeyado bilvad velo yeshallem shimon kelum. taan reuven sheshshimon yodea bevadday bifchat zo sheppachatu yegalgel al shimon sheeno yodea bevadday sechum happechat hazze. veim lo nitassek shimon beshuttafut zo kelal yishshava shimon hesset sheeno yodea bevadday beze hahefsed veyippater. velo od ella im haya ze hammane hannishar beyad shimon cholkim oto beshave. sheen hashuttaf min hannishbain venotlin kede sheyyishshava veyittol ma shebbeyad chavero ella nishba veniftar o notel middavar shehu tachat yado. vehizzaher bedin ze shekkevar tau bo baale horaa:

Taan shimon sheyyesh lelevi alav chov bezo hashshuttafut mane. im haya beyado kede hachov vehaya yachol litteno lelevi neeman venotnin hachov veachar kach mechashshevin. veim en beyado litten eno neeman lehotzi miyyad reuven o min hassechora hayedua leshuttafut shemma kenuneya hem osin shimon velevi al nichse reuven. afillu hayta hammilve bishtar en reuven chayyav leshallem mimmenna kelum. aval im taan shimon sheruven yodea bevadday shezze hachov shealay mechamat hashshuttafut hu vehachov etzlenu hu yishshava reuven hesset o al yede gilgul sheeno yodea shechov ze etzlenu vishallem shimon hachov mishshello. vechen im yatza shetar chov al levi beshem shimon bemea dinarin mimmamon hashshuttafut veamar shimon nifrati vehechzarti lakkis. o sheamar shimon kavati lo zeman leshana o lishtayim. eno neeman shemma kenuneya hu ose al nichse reuven. vketzad danin bedin ze. levi kevar niftar behodaat shimon. veim lo hevi shimon reaya yeshallem mibbeto veyitba et levi besof zeman sheamar. vechen kol kayyotze baze: seliku lehu hilchot sheluchin veshuttappin
Mishneh Torah, Slaves 1:
<small>(Shemot 21 2)</small> "eved ivri" haamur battora ze yisreeli shemmachru oto bet din al karcho o hammocher atzmo lirtzono. ketzad. ganav veen lo leshallem et hakkeren bet din mochrin oto kemo sheamarnu behilchot geneva. veen lecha ish beyisrael shemmochrin oto bet din ella haggannav bilvad. veal ze shemmecharuhu bet din hu omer <small>(Shemot 21 2)</small> "ki tikne eved ivri". vealav hu omer bemishne tora <small>(Devarim 15 12)</small> "ki yimmacher lecha achicha haivri". mocher atzmo ketzad. ze yisrael sheheeni beyoter natna lo tora reshut limkor et atzmo shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 39)</small> "ki yamuch achicha immach venimkar lecha". veeno rashshay limkor et atzmo ulehatznia et damav o liknot bahem sechora o kelim o littenem levaal chov ella im ken tzarich leachlan bilvad. veen adam rashshay limkor et atzmo ad shello yishshaer lo kelum vaafillu kesut lo tishshaer lo veachar kach yimkor et atzmo: 
Kevar bearnu sheen haishsha nimkeret bignevatah vechen enah mocheret et atzmah veenah kona lo eved ivri velo eved kenaani mippene hachashad. veen hagger nikne beeved ivri shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 41)</small> "veshav el mishpachto" mi sheyyesh lo mishpacha: 
Eved ivri shemmecharuhu bet din en mochrin oto ella leyisrael o leger tzedek. vechen hammocher atzmo eno rashshay limkor atzmo leakkum vaafillu leger toshav. veim avar umachar atzmo afillu leakkum vaafillu laavodat kochavim atzmah hare ze machur shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 47)</small> "o leeker mishpachat ger". leeker ze hannimkar laavodat kochavim atzmah: 
Ba veamar lecha hareni mocher atzmi leakkum en atta zakuk lo ad sheyyimmacher aval leachar shennimkar leakkum af al pi sheavar veasa shello kahogen mitzva lifdoto velo yittama bahem shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 48)</small> "achare nimkar geulla tihye lo": 
Echad hammocher et atzmo o shemmecharuhu bet din eno nimkar befarhesya al even hammikkach velo besimta kederech shehaavadim nimkarin shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 42)</small> "lo yimmachru mimkeret aved" eno nimkar ella betzina vederech kavod: 
Kol eved ivri asur laavod bo befarech. veezo hi avodat parech zo avoda sheen lah kitzva vaavoda sheeno tzarich lah ella tihye machshavto lehaavido bilvad shello yibbatel. mikkan amru chachamim shello yomar lo ador tachat haggefanim ad sheavo shehare lo natan lo kitzva. ella yomar lo ador ad shaa pelonit o ad makom peloni. vechen lo yomar lo chafor makom ze vehu eno tzarich lo. vaafillu lehachem lo kos shel chammin o lehatzen veeno tzarich lo asur veover alav belo taase shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 43)</small> "lo tirde vo befarech". ha eno ose lo ella davar katzuv shehu tzarich lo. vechen haakkum shennimkar lo im rada bo befarech hare yisrael metzuvvin lemano. veim hinnichuhu ovrim belo taase shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 53)</small> "lo yirdennu beferech leenecha". veen anu nizkakin lichnos lirshuto shel akkum velivdok acharav shello yaavidennu befarech shenneemar leenecha bizman sheatta roe: 
Kol eved ivri asur leyisrael shekkanahu lehaavido bidvarim bozim shehem meyuchadim laasot haavadim kegon sheyyolich acharav kelav levet hammerchatz o yachlotz lo minalav shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 39)</small> "lo taavod bo avodat aved". eno noheg bo ella kesachir shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 40)</small> "kesachir ketoshav yihye immach". umuttar lesapper lo searo ulechabbes lo kesuto veleefot lo issato. aval lo yaase oto ballan larabbim o sappar larabbim o nachtom larabbim. veim hayta ummanuto zot kodem sheyyimmacher hare ze yaase. aval lo yelammedenu battechilla melacha kelal ella ummanut shehaya bah hu sheose keshehaya ose mikkodem. bamme devarim amurim beeved ivri mippene shennafsho shefala bimchira. aval yisrael shello nimkar muttar lehishtammesh bo keeved shehare eno ose melacha zo ella birtzono umiddaat atzmo: 
Anashim sheenan nohagin kashshura muttar lirdotan bechazka ulehishtabed bahen. melech sheggazar shekkol mi shello yitten hammas hakkatzuv al kol ish veish yishtabed leze shennatan hammas al yado hare ze muttar lehishtammesh bo yoter midday aval lo keeved. veim eno noheg kashshura muttar lehishtammesh bo keeved: 
Kol eved ivri o ama haivriyya chayyav haadon lehashevotan lo bemaachol uvemashke bichsut uvemador shenneemar <small>(Devarim 15 16)</small> "ki tov lo immach" shello tehe atta ochel pat naki vehu ochel pat kibbar atta shote yayin yashan vehu shote yayin chadash atta yashen al gabbe mochin vehu yashen al gabbe hatteven atta dar bichrach vehu dar bichfar o atta dar bichfar vehu yoshev bichrach. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 41)</small> "veyatza meimmach". mikkan amru kol hakkone eved ivri kekone adon leatzmo. vechayyav linhog bo minhag achva shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 46)</small> "uveachechem bene yisrael". veaf al pi chen tzarich haeved linhog beatzmo minhag avdut beotan haavodot shehu ose lo: 
En ama haivriyya noheget velo eved ivri noheg ella bizman shehayyovel noheg. ben eved ivri shemmocher atzmo ben ze shemmecharuhu bet din. uchevar bearnu matay batlu hayyovlot:
Mishneh Torah, Slaves 2:
Eved ivri shemmecharuhu bet din [vehammocher atzmo] nikne bechesef uvishve kesef uvishtar. ketzad bishtar. kotev lo al hanneyar o al hacheres hareni machur lecha hareni kanuy lecha venoten lo hashshetar: 
Mecharuhu bet din oved shesh shanim miyyom mechirato uvitchillat hashshana hashsheviit shello yetze ben chorin. veim paga bo shenat hashshemitta bichlal hashshesh hare ze oved bah. aval im paga bo shenat yovel afillu nimkar shana achat lifne hayyovel hare ze yetze lecherut shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 40)</small> "ad shenat hayyovel yaavod immach" <small>(Vayikra 25 13)</small> "bishnat hayyovel hazzot" vegomer: 
Hammocher atzmo yesh lo limkor atzmo leyeter al shesh. hare shemmachar atzmo leeser shanim o leesrim shana ufaga bo yovel afillu achar shana hare ze yotze bayyovel shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 40)</small> "ad shenat hayyovel yaavod immach": 
Echad hammocher atzmo o shemmecharuhu bet din uvarach chayyav lehashelim shesh. veim paga bo yovel yotze lecherut: 
Chala ben shechala shana achar shana o shechala cholaim mekuttaim im hakkol pachot mearba shanim olin leminyan shesh. aval im chala arba shanim chayyav lehashelim kol yeme hacholi shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 40)</small> "kesachir ketoshav". veim paga bo yovel yetze. bamme devarim amurim shemmechashshevin yeme hacholi keshehaya chalyo kaved sheeno yachol laasot melacha. aval im lo haya chalyo kaved ella yachol laasot maase machat afillu chala kol shesh olin lo: 
Hammocher atzmo leakkum im lo nifda eno yotze ella bayyovel shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 54)</small> "veim lo yiggael beelle veyatza bishnat hayyovel hu uvanav immo": 
Hannimkar leakkum im lo hissiga yado ligl kerovav podin oto vekarov karov kodem shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 49)</small> "o dodo o ven dodo yigalennu". uvet din kofin et kerovav lifdoto shello yittama baakkum. lo pedauhu kerovav o sheen yadam masseget mitzva al kol adam miyyisrael lifdoto. uven sheppedauhu kerovim ben sheppedaahu shear adam yetze lecherut. veyesh lo lilvot veligl et atzmo min haakkum. vegoel lachatzain. aval hannimkar leyisrael en hakkerovim podin oto veen lo vegoel veeno goel lachatzain. ella ketzad dino. im hissiga yado litten kefi hashshanim hannotarot noten veyotze veim lav lo yetze: 
Echad hammocher atzmo ben leyisrael ben leakkum veechad shemmecharuhu bet din hare ze megarea mippidyono veyotze. ketzad. hare shemmecharuhu beshishshim dinarim veavad arba shanim umatza yado hare ze noten esrim dinarim veyetze lecherut. vechen im machar atzmo bearbaim dinarin leeser shanim hare ze megarea arbaa dinarin lechol shana sheavad venoten hannishar kesef o sheve kesef veyotze. vechen hannimkar leakkum mechashshev haddamim lefi hashshanim hannisharot ad shenat hayyovel shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 50)</small> "vechishshav im konehu mishshenat himmachro lo ad shenat hayyovel". ketzad. machar atzmo bemea venishar layyovel mishshenat mechira eser shanim mechashshev asara lechol shana sheavad vegorea haddamim umeshiv hashshear kesef lo tevua velo kelim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 50)</small> "kesef mimkaro" bechesef hu nigal miyyad haakkum veeno nigal bishve kesef: 
Kol eved ivri o ivriyya sheyyatza begiron kesef vehivri vehosifu damav o nishchaf ufachatu damav mechashshevin lo lehakel alav. ketzad. hare shennimkar bemea vahare hu atta shave matayim eno mechashshev im adonav ella lefi mea. nimkar bematayim vahare hu shave mea mechashshev immo al pi hashshanim hannotarot lefi mea: 
Hannimkar leakkum hoil veyesh ligl atzmo lachatzain kemo shebbearnu peamim yihye lehakel ufeamim lehachemir. ketzad lehakel. kana oto bematayim venishchaf vahare hu atta shave mea venatan lo chamishshim chatzi damav vehivri vahare hu shave matayim noten lo mea shehen chatzi damav hannishar veyatza. ketzad lehachemir. kana oto bematayim venatan lo chatzi damav shehen mea venishchaf vahare atta shave mea noten lo chamishshim shehen deme chetzyo hannishar venimtza shennatan mea vachamishshim af al pi shehu atta shave mea: 
Harav shemmachal laeved al hakkesef shennishar lo laavod kenegdo eno machul lo ad sheyyichtov lo shetar shichrur. ketzad. hare shekkanahu beshishshim veavad shana o shenatayim veamar lo shear haddamim mechulin lecha lech ledarkecha lo niftar mishshibudo ad sheyyichtov lo shetar: 
Adon shemmet im hinniach ben zachar hare haeved oved habben ad sof hashshesh o ad sof hashshanim shemmachar atzmo lahen o ad sheyyifga bo yovel o ad sheyyegarea pidyono veyitten hashshear. aval im lo hinniach ben zachar hare ze yetze lecherut veeno oved lo et habbat velo et haach veen tzarich lomar sheeno oved shear hayyorshin. vehannimkar leger tzedek o leakkum afillu habben eno oved ella kevan shemmet haadon yetze lecherut. nimtzeta omer sheeved ivri nikne bechesef o bishtar vekone et atzmo bachamishsha devarim. beshanim o beyovel o begiron kesef o bishtar shichrur o bemitat adon belo ben uveakkum o beger afillu hinniach ben. mitzva lomar lo tze bishat yetziato. af al pi shello amar lo hare hu yotze bechinnam. veeno tzarich shetar. afillu chala vehotzi rabbo alav hotzaot harebe eno chayyav lo kelum shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 2)</small> "yetze lachafshi chinnam":
Mishneh Torah, Slaves 3:
Kol eved ivri hare haadon chayyav bimzonot ishto hannesua lo velo arusa veshomeret yavam. vehu shettihye mutteret lo. aval im hayta meissure lavin afillu sheniyya eno chayyav bimzonoteha shenneemar ishto immo ishsha haruya laamod immo. vechen chayyav bimzonot banav uvenotav. bimcharuhu bet din neemar <small>(Shemot 21 3)</small> "im baal ishsha hu veyatza ishto immo". vechi taale al datecha shekkevan shennikna ze nishtabeda ishto. aval lo ba lelammed ella shehaadon chayyav bimzonoteha. uvemocher atzmo neemar <small>(Vayikra 25 41)</small> "veyatza meimmach hu uvanav immo". uvenimkar leakkum neemar <small>(Vayikra 25 54)</small> "veyatza bishnat hayyovel hu uvanav immo". echad ishsha uvanim shehayu lo bishat mechira o ishsha uvanim shehayu lo achar mechirato. vehu sheyyikkachenna middaat haadon. aval im lekachah shello middaat rabbo eno chayyav bimzonoteha: 
Af al pi shehaadon chayyav bimzonot ishto uvanav en lo bemaase yedehem kelum ella hare maase haishsha umetziatah levaalah. vechol shezzoche habbaal beishto zoche ze af al pi shehu eved ivri: 
Mi shemmecharuhu bet din yesh lerabbo litten lo shifcha kenaanit. ben haadon ben beno shel adon im met aviv hare ze noten lo shifcha. vechofehu al ze kede sheyyolid mimmenna avadim. vahare hi mutteret lo kol yeme avduto shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 4)</small> "im adonav yitten lo ishsha" vegomer. vehammocher atzmo asur beshifcha kenaanit kishar kol yisrael: 
En eved ivri muttar beshifcha kenaanit ad shettihye lo ishsha yisreelit uvanim. aval im en lo ishsha uvanim en rabbo moser lo shifcha kenaanit. vedavar ze kabbala hu afillu haya hannimkar kohen hare ze muttar beshifcha kenaanit kol yeme avduto: 
Im hayu lo ishsha uvanim af al pi shemmoser lo rabbo shifcha kenaanit eno yachol lehaferisho meishto uvanav shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 3)</small> "ishto immo". veeno yachol litten lo shete shefachot. velo litten shifcha achat lishne avadav haivrim kederech shennoten lakkenaaniyyim shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 4)</small> "yitten lo ishsha". nirtza shemmasar lo rabbo shifcha kenaanit vehiggia yovel vehaya rabbo mesarev bo latzet veeno rotze latzet vechaval bo patur shehare neesar beshifcha: 
Hammocher atzmo eno nirtza. aval mecharuhu bet din veavad shesh velo ratza latzet hare ze nirtza veoved ad shenat hayyovel o ad sheyyamut haadon: 
Af al pi shehinniach ben en hannirtza oved et habben mippi hashshemua lamdu <small>(Shemot 21 6)</small> "vaavado", lo velo livno. <small>(Shemot 21 6)</small> "leolam", leolamo shel yovel. nimtzeta lamed shehannirtza eno kone et atzmo ella bayyovel uvemitat haadon: 
Eved ivri kohen eno nirtza mippene shennaasa baal mum vahare hu omer <small>(Vayikra 25 41)</small> "veshav el mishpachto" lachazaka shehaya bah. veeno shav lasserara shehaya bah: 
Ketzad rotzin. mevio levet din shel shelosha veomer devarav lifnehem umaggisho lesof shesh el haddelet o el hammezuza keshehen omdin bevinyan. ben delet umezuza shel adon ben shel kol adam. venokev et azno hayemanit begufah shel ozen bemartzea shel mattechet ad sheyyaggia laddelet shenneemar <small>(Devarim 15 17)</small> "venatatta veazno uvaddelet". velo neemar <small>(Shemot 21 6)</small> "mezuza" ella sheyyihye omed ben etzel delet ben etzel mezuza. uma mezuza keshehi omedet af delet keshehi omedet. aval hartzia baddelet af al pi sheen sham mezuza. haadon hu sherotzea beatzmo shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 6)</small> "veratza adonav" lo beno velo shelucho velo sheliach bet din. veen rotzin shene avadim keechad sheen osin mitzvot chavilot chavilot: 
<small>(Shemot 21 5)</small> "veim amor yomar haeved" ad sheyyomar veyishne. haeved ad sheyyomar keshehu eved aval im amar achar shesh eno nirtza ad sheyyomar veyishne besof shesh bitchillat peruta acharona. ketzad. kegon shennishar min hayyom sheve peruta middeme mechirato o yeter meat. aval im nishar pachot mishsheve peruta hare ze keomer achar shesh: 
Hayta laeved shifcha kenaanit velo mimmenna banim ulerabbo en ishsha uvanim eno nirtza shenneemar <small>(Devarim 15 16)</small> "ki ahevcha veet betecha". lerabbo ishsha uvanim velo en ishsha uvanim eno nirtza shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 5)</small> "ahavti et adoni et ishti veet banay". hu ohev et rabbo verabbo eno ohavo eno nirtza shenneemar ki tov lo immach. rabbo ohavo vehu eno ohev et rabbo eno nirtza shenneemar ki ahevcha. hu chole verabbo eno chole eno nirtza shenneemar ki tov lo immach. rabbo chole vehu eno chole o shehayu shenehem cholim eno nirtza shenneemar <small>(Devarim 15 16)</small> "ki tov lo immach" ad sheyyihyu shenehem betova: 
Ma ben mocher atzmo limcharuhu bet din. mocher atzmo eno nirtza umecharuhu bet din nirtza. mocher atzmo asur beshifcha kenaanit umecharuhu bet din rabbo moser lo shifcha kenaanit. mocher atzmo nimkar leakkum umecharuhu bet din eno nimkar ella leyisrael shenneemar <small>(Devarim 15 12)</small> "ki yimmacher lecha achicha" en bet din mochrin oto ella lecha. mocher atzmo nimkar leshesh veyeter al shesh mecharuhu bet din eno nimkar ella leshesh. mocher atzmo en maanikin lo mecharuhu bet din maanikin lo: 
Mippi hashshemua lamdu sheen haishsha nirtzaat vechen yerae meinyan hakkatuv shehare omer benirtza <small>(Shemot 21 5)</small> "ahavti et adoni et ishti veet banay". umahu shenneemar <small>(Devarim 15 17)</small> "veaf laamatcha taase ken". lehaanik. shekkeshem shemmitzvat ase lehaanik eved ivri kach maanik ama haivriyya: 
Kol hameshalleach avdo vaamato rekam over belo taase shenneemar <small>(Devarim 15 13)</small> "lo teshallechennu rekam" vahare hakkatuv nitteko laase shenneemar <small>(Devarim 15 14)</small> "haanek taanik lo". echad hayyotze besof shesh o sheyyatza beyovel o bemitat haadon vechen haama haivriyya sheyyatzat beechad mikkol ellu o besimanin hare ellu maanikin lahem. aval hayyotze begiron kesef en maanikin lahem shenneemar <small>(Devarim 15 13)</small> "vechi teshallechennu chafshi meimmach" veze lo shillecho chafshi ella haeved natan shear haddamim shennishar lo laavod bahen veachar kach yatza. <small>(Devarim 15 14)</small> "haanek taanik lo mitztzoncha miggarnecha umiyyikvecha" beinyan tzon goren veyekev devarim sheyyesh bahem beracha mechamat atzman hu shechayyav lehaanik lo mehem aval hakkesafim vehabbegadim eno chayyav litten lo mehem. vechamma noten lo en pachot mishsheve sheloshim sela ben mimmin echad ben mimminin harebe kishloshim shel kenas haeved shenneemar bo <small>(Shemot 21 32)</small> "yitten ladonav". ben shennitbarech habbayit biglalo ben shello nitbarech shenneemar haanek taanik lo mikkol makom. im ken lamma neemar <small>(Devarim 15 14)</small> "asher berachcha" hakkol lefi habberacha ten lo: 
Im barach ufaga bo yovel keshehu boreach veyatza lecherut eno chayyav lehaaniko shenneemar <small>(Devarim 15 13)</small> "vechi teshallechennu" vegomer. enek eved ivri leatzmo veen baal chov gove hemennu. veenek ama haivriyya vechen metziatah leaviha. veim met aviha kodem sheyyavo leyado hare hen shel atzmah veen leacheha bahem kelum sheen adam morish zechut sheyyesh lo bevitto livno:
Mishneh Torah, Slaves 4: Ama haivriyya hi hakketanna shemmecharah aviha. umishshettavi shete searot achar shetem esre shana vetease naara eno yachol lemachrah af al pi sheadayin yesh lo reshut bah. veyesh lo lekaddeshah lechol mi sheyyirtze. af hakketanna shehi aylonit besimaneha veenah reuya lahavaat shete searot yesh leaviha lemachrah kol zeman shehi ketanna. aval hattumtum vehaanderoginus eno nimkar lo keeved ivri velo kedin haama haivriyya:

En haav rashshay limkor et bitto ella im ken heeni velo nishar lo kelum lo karka velo mittaltelin vaafillu kesut shealav. veaf al pi chen kofin et haav lifdotah achar shemmecharah mishshum pegam mishpacha. barach haav o shemmet o shello haya lo lifdotah hare zo ovedet ad shettetze:

Ama haivriyya niknet bechesef o bishve kesef uvishtar veenah niknet bifruta mippene shetztzarich liknotah bedamim sheruyin legeraon kede shettigra pidyonah vetetze. ketzad bishtar. kotev al hanneyar o al hacheres bitti mechura lecha bitti kenuya lecha venoten beyad haadon. ushetar ama haivriyya haav kotvo:

Ama haivriyya ovedet shesh shanim keeved shemmecharuhu bet din shenneemar <small>(Devarim 15 12)</small> "ki yimmacher lecha achicha haivri o haivriyya". veyotzet bitchillat sheva. veim paga bah yovel betoch shesh yotza chinnam keeved. met haadon af al pi shehinniach ben yotza chinnam kenirtza shenneemar <small>(Devarim 15 17)</small> "veaf laamatcha taase ken". vechen megaraat mippidyonah veyotza. veim katav lah shetar shichrur umachal al hashshear yotza chinnam keeved:

Yetera ama haivriyya shehi yotza besimanin. ketzad. kegon shehevia simanin venaaset naara yotza lecherut belo kesef afillu hevia simanin meachar yom shellekachah hare zo yotzet lecherut shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 11)</small> "veyatza chinnam" ribba lah hakkatuv yetzia acheret bechinnam yeter al haeved. mippi hashshemua lamdu shehi havaat simane naarut. vetachzor lirshut aviha ad shettivgor vetetze mershut aviha. hayta habbat aylonit sheen lah yeme naarut ella yotzet mikkatnutah leveger kevan shebbagra tetze lecherut:

En ama haivriyya yotza berashe evarim shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 7)</small> "lo tetze ketzet haavadim". vechen eved ivri im hippil lo shinno o simme lo eno meshallem lo kedin hachovel bachavero kemo shebbearnu behilchot chovel. nimtzeta lamed sheama haivriyya niknet bishne devarim bechesef o bishtar. vekona atzmah beshishsha devarim beshanim uveyovel uvegiron kesef uvishtar shichrur uvemitat haadon uvesimanin:

Yied otah haadon leatzmo o livno hare hi kishar arusot veenah yotza beechad mikkol ellu ella bemitat habbaal o beget. umitzvat yiud kodemet lemitzvat pediyya. ketzad mitzvat yiud. omer lah bifne shenayim hare at mekuddeshet li hare at meoreset li hare at li leishsha afillu besof shesh samuch lishkiat hachamma. veeno tzarich litten lah kelum shemmaot harishonot lekiddushin nittenu venoheg bah minhag ishut veeno noheg bah minhag shefachot. veeno meyaed shetayim keachat shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 8)</small> "yeadah". vechetzad meyaadah livno. im haya beno gadol venatan reshut leaviv leyaadah lo hare haav omer lah bifne shenayim hare at mekuddeshet livni:

En haadon meyaed ama haivriyya lo lo velo livno ella middatah af al pi shekkevar kibbel aviha meoteha shehare hu omer <small>(Shemot 21 8)</small> "yeadah" middatah. veim met haadon en beno yuchal leyaadah lo shehare yotza lecherut bemitat haadon:

Hayyiud keerusin veeno kenissuin lefichach eno mittamme lah velo yirashenna velo mefer nedareha ad shettikkanes lechuppa. <small>(Shemot 21 11)</small> "veim shelash elle lo yaase lah", lo yiadah lo velo yiadah livno velo nifdet begiron kesef, veyatza chinnam bahavaat simanin kemo shebbearnu:

Yeter al otan hadderachim shekkona bahen atzmah keeved ivri. en haadon yachol limkor ama haivriyya velo littenah leish acher ben rachok ben karov veim machar o natan lo asa kelum shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 8)</small> "leam nachri lo yimshol lemachrah bevigdo vah". vechen eved ivri lo yachol lemachro leacher velo litteno. veyerae li shello hutzrach hakkatuv leesor davar ze [beama] ella mippene sheyyesh lo leyaadah livno lechach neemar leam nachri lo yimshol lemachrah:

En ama haivriyya nimkeret ella lemi sheyyesh lah alav o livno kiddushin kede shettehe reuya leyiud. ketzad. mocher adam et bitto leaviv sheaf al pi sheen haadon yachol leyaadah lo reuya hi livno shehare haama bat achiv. aval eno yachol limkor et bitto livno mippene sheenah reuya leadon shehare hi achoto velo livno mippene shehi achot aviv:
Yesh leadam limkor bitto lifsulin kegon almana lechohen gadol gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedyot sheaf al pi shehen belav kiddushin tofsin bahen:

Hamekaddesh et bitto keshehi ketanna venitarmela o nitgarsha eno yachol lemachrah sheen adam yachol limkor et bitto leshifchut achar ishut. aval mochrah leshifcha achar shifchut. ketzad. mecharah leshifchut techilla veyied otah haadon umet haadon o gershah vechazra lirshut haav keshehi ketanna hare haav mochrah paam sheniyya afillu lechohen. vechen im nafla lifne yavam min hayyiud vechalatz lah af al pi shehi chalitza pesula mippene shehi ketanna hare nifsela min hakkehunna veyesh lo lemachrah lechohen hoil vekiddushin tofsin bah kemo shennitbaer:
Hammocher et bitto veyatza beshanim o beyovel o begiron kesef vaadayin hi ketanna yesh lo lachzor ulemachrah paam sheniyya kemo shebbearnu:
Hammocher et bitto veachar kach halach vekiddeshah leacher im ratza haadon leyaed meyaed veim lo yied haadon lo lo velo livno keshettetze mershut haadon yiggamru kiddusheha vetease eshet ish:
Hammocher et bitto ufasak al haadon al menat shello leyaed otah im ratza haadon leyaed meyaed shehitna al ma shekkatuv battora shettenao batel:
Mishneh Torah, Slaves 5: Eved kenaani nikne bachamishsha devarim vekone et atzmo bishlosha. nikne bechesef o bishtar o bachazaka o bachalifin o bimshicha. vekone et atzmo bechesef o bishtar o berashe evarim. veeved katan hare hu kivhema venikne bimshicha kimshichat habbehema. uchevar bearnu bitchillat sefer ze kol hadderachim shehaavadim niknin bahen:

Ketzad kone et atzmo bechesef. kegon shennatan echad lerabbo maot veamar lo al menat sheyyetze avdecha bahem lecherut kevan shekkibbel harav et hakkesef o sheve kesef yatza haeved lecherut. veen tzarich daat haeved shezzechut hi lo vezachin leadam shello befanav. vechen im natan echad leeved maot veamar al menat shettetze bahem lecherut im ratza haadon lekabbel hammaot yatza haeved lecherut veim lo ratza lo kana haeved hammaot shello natan lo ella al menat sheyyetze bahem lecherut. veechad hakkesef o sheve kesef ben liknoto ben lehakenot atzmo lo:

Ketzad bishtar. kotev lo al hanneyar o al hacheres hare at ben chorin o hare at shel atzmecha o en li esek becha. vechen kol kayyotze baze beinyan ze shezze hu gufo shel get shichrur. umoser lo et hashshetar bifne shene edim o shehayu haedim chatumim bo umesaro lo beno leveno. hare ze yatza lecherut shehare gitto veyado bain keechad. amar lo shello bichtav hare at ben chorin hare at shel atzmecha af al pi sheheidu alav edim bevet din veaf al pi shekkanu miyyado adayin lo nishtachrer sheen haeved yotze lecherut ella bechesef o bishtar o berashe evarim. vhakkotev leshifchato hare at mutteret lechol adam lo amar kelum:

Ketzad berashe evarim. hammakke et avdo bechavvana vchisro echad meesrim vearbaa rashe evarim sheenan chozrin yatza lecherut vetzarich get shichrur. im ken lamma neemar battora <small>(Shemot 21 27)</small> "shen" v <small>(Shemot 21 26)</small> "ayin" liddon mehen ma shen veayin mumin shebbegaluy veenan chozrin af kol mumin shebbegaluy veenan chozrin yetze haeved bo lecherut. aval hamesares avdo babbetzim o hachotech leshono eno yotze lecherut sheenan mumin shebbegaluy. vechen hammappil shen hakkatan eno yotze lecherut shehare sofo lachzor:

En yotze berashe evarim ella avadim shemmalu vetavlu shehare yeshnan bemiktzat mitzvot aval haeved shehu begeuto eno yotze berashe evarim. ellu hen rashe evarim sheenan chozrin. etzbeot yadayim veraglayim esrim rashe haaznayim verosh hachotem verosh haggeviyya verashe haddadin shebbaishsha aval haenayim vehashshinnayim hare hen meforashin battora:

Hayta lo etzba yetera vachatachah im nisperet al gav hayyad eved yotze bah lecherut. hayta eno semuya vechittah eved yotze bah lecherut shehare chissero evar. vehu haddin leechad merashe evarim shehu batel veeno ose bo melacha sheim chatacho hare chissero evar veyatza lecherut:
Hikkahu al eno vesimmeah al azno vechershah eved yotze bahen lecherut. hikkahu keneged eno veeno roe keneged azno veeno shomea en eved yotze bahen lecherut:
Hikkahu al eno vechasra meorah. al shinno veniddedah. im yachol lehishtammesh bahem eno yotze lecherut veim lav yetze lecherut:
Hayta eno keha vechisser meorah o shinno nodedet vehikkahu haadon vehippil hashshen hannodedet o simme haayin hakkeha im haya mishtammesh bahen kol shehu yetze lecherut veim lav lo yetze lecherut:
Hikkahu al yado vetzavta yado vesofah lachzor eno yotze lecherut. talash bizkano vedildel bo etzem min hallechi yetze lecherut shehare bittel maase hashshinnayim hakkevuot beoto haetzem:

Hippil et shinno o simme et eno belo kavvana kegon shezzarak even livhema venafla baeved vehippila et shinno vechatcha etzbao lo yetze lecherut shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 27)</small> "im shen avdo o shen amato yappil" ad sheyyitkavven:
Hoshit yado lime shifchato vesimme en haubbar shebbemeeha lo yetze lecherut shehare lo yada davar sheyyitkavven lo:

Hare shehaya rabbo rofe veamar lo kechol li eni vesimmeah chator li shinni vehippilah sachak baadon veyetze lecherut sheaf al pi shello nitkavven lehazzik hare nitkavven lingoa beevre haeved venistakken bahen. veen tzarich lomar im hayta en haeved koevet vehaya rabbo umman vaakarah lo shehare yetze lecherut:
Hammappil shen avdo vesimme et eno hare yetze lecherut beshinno venoten lo deme eno. vechen kol kayyotze baze:
Mi shechetzyo eved vechetzyo ben chorin veeved shel shene shuttafin eno yotze berashe evarim lefi sheeno meyuchad lerabbo shechaval bo:

Avde tzon barzel yotzin berashe evarim im chisseran habbaal aval lo haishsha. veavde melog enan yotzin berashe evarim lo im hippil habbaal shehare en lo bahem ella perot velo im hippila otan haishsha mippene sheenan meyuchadin lah:

Yetziat haeved berashe evarim noheg bechol makom uvechol zeman veen danin bo ella bevet din semuchin mippene shehu kenas. lefichach haeved sheamar lerabbo hippalta et shinni vesimmeta et eni vehaadon omer lo asiti ze patur sheim yode meatzmo eno chayyav lehotzio lecherut belo edim shehammode biknas patur kemo shebbearnu behilchot geneva shekkol mode biknas patur milleshallemo:
Mishneh Torah, Slaves 6: Hakkotev get shichrur leavdo vezikka lo bo al yede acher veamar zeche beget ze lifloni avdi yatza lecherut af al pi shello higgia get leyado shezzachin leadam shello befanav. aval im amar tenu get ze leavdi eno yachol lachzor bo velo yetze haeved lecherut ad sheyyaggia hagget leyado. lefichach haomer tenu get ze leavdi umet lo yittenu leachar mita:
Hakkotev bishtar asiti peloni avdi ben chorin o naasa peloni avdi ben chorin o hare hu ben chorin hare ze yetze lecherut. katav bashshetar eesennu ben chorin lo yetze lecherut:

Haomer asiti peloni avdi ben chorin vehu omer lo asaani choshshin shemma zikka lo al yede acher. amar katavti get shichrur venatatti lo vehu amar lo katav velo natan hodaat baal din kemea edim vahare ze eved ad sheyyeshachrerenu befanenu:

Mi shetztzivva bishat mitato pelonit shifchati al yishtabedu bah yorshay hare zo shifcha keshehayta veasur layyorshim lehishtabed bah mippene shemmitzva lekayyem divre hammet. vechen im amar asu lah korat ruach kofin et hayyorshin veen mishtabedin bah ella bimlacha shehi rotza bah. tzivva veamar shachreruha kofin et hayyorshin leshachrer otah:

Beshishsha devarim shavin shichrure avadim legitte nashim uvishar devarim hare hen kishar kol hashshetarot. veellu hen hashshishsha. pesulim bearkaot shel akkum. uchesherin beed kuti. utzerichin ketiva leshem hammeshuchrar atzmo. veen nichtavin bimchubbar. veen chotmin edehem ella ze bifne ze. echad gitte nashim veechad shichrure avadim shavin lammolich velammevi. ketzad. kol hashshetarot haolim bearkaot shel akkum kesherim bechol hattenaim sheanu mevaarim behilchot halevaa chutz miggitte nashim veshichrure avadim:

Kol shetar sheyyesh alav afillu ed echad kuti pasul chutz miggitte nashim veshichrure avadim shehen kesherin beed echad yisrael veed echad kuti vehu sheyyihye kuti chaver. uvazzeman hazze shehakkutim keakkum lechol divrehem anu lemedin mehen litzdokin shehatztzedokin bazzeman hazze kemo kuti beoto hazzeman kodem sheggazru alehem sheyyihyu keakkum lechol divrehem. beget ishsha hu omer <small>(Devarim 24 1)</small> "vechatav lah" lishmah uveget shichrur hu omer <small>(Vayikra 19 20)</small> "o chufsha lo nittan lah", ad sheyyichtov lishmah. beget ishsha hu omer vechatav venatan mi sheeno mechussar ella netina yatza hakkotev bimchubbar veachar kach kitztzetz shehare mechussar ketzitza unetina uveget shichrur hu omer (venatan lah) lo yihye mechussar ella netina. echad gitte nashim veshichrure avadim enan chotmin edehem ella ze bifne ze. uchevar bearnu taam haddavar behilchot gerushin:

Vechetzad shavin bemolich umevi shehammevi get shichrur beeretz yisrael en tzarich lomar befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam uvechutza laaretz im en edim metzuyin lekayyemo veamar hashshaliach befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam zehu kiyyumo. veim ba haadon veirer achar kach en mashgichin bo kemo shebbearnu begitte nashim. keshem shehaishsha atzmah mevia gittah veenah tzericha lekayyemo hoil vehagget yotze mittachat yadah kach haeved sheshshetar shichrur yotze mittachat yado eno tzarich lekayyemo. ucheshem shehaishsha omeret befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam im hitna aleha kemo shebbearnu bimkomo kach haeved shehevi get veamar befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam neeman al oto hadderech veen tzarich kiyyum:

Kol hakkasher lehavi get haishsha kasher lehavi get haeved. vehaeved mekabbel get lachavero miyyad rabbo shel chavero aval lo miyyad rabbo shel mekabbel. hakkotev shetar erusin leshifchato af al pi sheamar lah tzei bo lecherut vehitkaddeshi bo en ballashon hazze leshon shichrur veenah mekuddeshet velo meshuchreret:
Mishneh Torah, Slaves 7:
Get shichrur tzarich sheyyihye inyano davar hakkoret beno leven adonav velo yishshaer laadon bo zechut. lefichach hakkotev leavdo atzmecha vechol nechasay kenuyin lecha chutz mimmakom peloni o chutz mittallit pelonit en ze koret vehagget batel umittoch sheeno get en haeved meshuchrar velo kana min hannechasim kelum. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Eved shehevi get vechatuv bo atzmecha unechasay kenuyin lecha atzmo kana vahare hu ben chorin aval hannechasim lo kana ad sheyyitkayyem hagget bechotmav kishar hashshetarot. vechen im haya katuv bo kol nechasay kenuyin lecha kana atzmo velo kana hannechasim ad sheyyitkayyem hagget bechotmav shecholkim haddibbur veomrim atzmo kana mippene shehu neeman lehavi get shichruro veeno tzarich lekayyemo aval hannechasim sheen adam kone otam ella biraya berura lo yikne otam ad sheyyitkayyem hashshetar: 
Hameshachrer shene avadim bishtar echad lo kanu atzman ella kotvin shetar lechol echad veechad. lefichach hakkotev kol nechasav lishne avadav bishtar echad af atzman lo kanu. veim katav bishne shetarot kanu umeshachrerin ze et ze. bamme devarim amurim beshekkatav bechol shetar mishshenehem kol nechasay netunim lifloni ufeloni avdi. aval im katav chatzi nechasay lifloni avdi vachatzi nechasay lifloni avdi af bishne shetarot lo kanu kelum shehaeved mikkelal nechasim vahare shiyyer bo chetzyo veen ze shichrur vechevan shello nishtachrer lo kana min hannechasim kelum: 
Hameshachrer chatzi avdo bishtar lo kana haeved chetzyo vahare hu eved keshehaya. aval im shichrer chetzyo bechesef kegon shellakach chatzi damav al menat leshachrer chetzyo kana venimtza chetzyo eved vechetzyo ben chorin. bamme devarim amurim besheshshichrer chetzyo bishtar vehinniach chetzyo. aval im shichrer chetzyo umachar chetzyo o sheshshichrer chetzyo venatan chetzyo bemattana hoil veyatza haeved kullo mershuto kana haeved chetzyo vahare ze chetzyo eved vechetzyo ben chorin. vechen eved shel shene shuttafin veshichrer echad mehen chelko ben bechesef ben bishtar kana haeved chetzyo vahare hu chetzyo eved vechetzyo ben chorin: 
Hakkotev leshifchato meubberet hare at bat chorin uveladech eved devarav kayyamin. hare at shifcha uveladech ben chorin lo amar velo kelum shezze kemi shemmeshachrer chetzyah: 
Shifcha charufa im ratza leshachrer chetzyah hannishar vetease eshet ish gemura hare ze meshachrer ben bechesef ben bishtar sheaf hakkesef gomer shichrurah: 
Mi shechetzyo eved vechetzyo ben chorin hoil veeno muttar lo beshifcha velo bevat chorin kofin et rabbo veose oto ben chorin vechotev shetar alav bachatzi damav. bamme devarim amurim beeved mippene shehaish metzuvve al periyya ureviyya. aval hashshifcha tishshaer kemot shehi veovedet et rabba yom echad veet atzmah yom echad. veim nahagu bah hachotim minhag hefker kofin et rabba leshachrer vechotev aleha shetar bachatzi dameha: 
Mi shechetzyo eved vechetzyo ben chorin sheamad rabbo vehikna chetzyo livno hakkatan kede shello yachofu oto bet din leshachrero maamidin bet din lakkatan appotroppos vechotev lo haappotroppos get shichrur vechotev lo shetar chov bachatzi damav. veim nitztarech hakkatan beeved veyesh lo gaguin alav mafligin oto mimmennu bemaot sheddato shel katan karov etzel maot: 
Shechiv mera shekkatav kol nechasav leavdo veamad chozer bannechasim veeno chozer baeved shehare yatza alav shem ben chorin:
Mishneh Torah, Slaves 8:
Hammocher et avdo leakkum yetze ben chorin vechofin et rabbo lachzor veliknoto min haakkum ad asara bedamav vechotev lo get shichrur veyotze. veim lo ratza haakkum lemachro afillu baasara bedamav en mechayyevin oto yeter. ukenas ze en govin oto vedanin oto ella bevet din mumchin. veim met hammocher en konsin et hayyoresh lehachezir et haeved leshichrur: 
Lava al avdo min haakkum im kava lo zeman veamar lo im higgia zeman peloni velo ashallem lecha tikne guf eved ze hare ze yetze lecherut miyyad. veim amar lo tikne maase yadav lo yetze lecherut. gevao akkum bechovo o shebbau al haadon metzerim uvikkeshu lehargo ufada atzmo miyyadan beavdo lo yatza lecherut mippene shennilkach mimmennu shello birtzono: 
Machar avdo leechad meavde hammelech o miggedolav af al pi shehu mityare mehem yatza haeved lecherut mippene shehaya yachol lefayyeso bemamon acher: 
Mecharo leakkum lishloshim yom. mecharo chutz mimmelachto. chutz min hammitzvot. chutz mishshabbatot veyamim tovim. hare ze safek im nishtachrer o lo nishtachrer. lefichach im tafas haeved kede damav lerabbo kede sheyyetze bahen lecherut miyyad akkum en motziin miyyado: 
Echad mocher avdo leakkum oved avoda zara o shemmecharo leger toshav afillu lechuti hare ze yetze lecherut. mecharo leyisrael mumar hare ze safek lefichach im tafas kede damav merabbo rishon kede latzet bahen miyyad hammumar en motziin miyyado: 
Hammocher avdo lechutza laaretz yatza ben chorin vechofin et rabbo hashsheni lichtov lo get shichrur veavdu haddamim. umippene ma kansu kan hallokeach levaddo sheillu lo lakach ze lo yatza haeved lechutza laaretz. hammocher avdo lesureya vaafillu leakko kemocher lechutza laaretz: 
Ben bavel shennasa ishsha beeretz yisrael vedato lachzor vehichnisa lo ishto avadim ushefachot hare ellu safek im hem kemi shemmachra otam lechutza laaretz hoil veyesh lo happerot o enan kimchurin lo shehare hagguf shellah: 
Eved sheyyatza achar rabbo lesureya umecharo sham ibbed et zechuto. bamme devarim amurim kesheyyatza rabbo al menat shello lachzor leeretz yisrael. aval im daat rabbo lachzor veyatza acharav umecharo sham yatza lecherut vechofin et hallokeach leshachrero: 
Eved sheamar laalot leeretz yisrael kofin et rabbo laalot immo o yimkor oto lemi sheyyaaluhu lesham. ratza haadon latzet lechutza laaretz eno yachol lehotzi et avdo ad sheyyirtze. vedin ze bechol zeman afillu bazzeman hazze shehaaretz beyad akkum: 
Eved shebbarach michutza laaretz laaretz en machazirin lo leavdut vealav neemar <small>(Devarim 23 16)</small> "lo tasgir eved el adonav". veomer lerabbo sheyyichtov lo get shichrur veyichtov lo shetar chov bedamav ad shettassig yado veyitten lo. veim lo ratza haadon leshachrero mafkiin bet din shibudo mealav veyelech lo: 
Eved ze shebbarach laaretz hare hu ger tzedek vehosif lo hakkatuv azhara acheret lemi shemmeanne oto mippene shehu shefal ruach yoter min hagger vetzivva alav hakkatuv shenneemar <small>(Devarim 23 17)</small> "immecha yeshev bekirbecha" <small>(Devarim 23 17)</small> "beachad shearecha" <small>(Devarim 23 17)</small> "battov lo lo tonennu". zo af honayat devarim. nimtzeta lamed shehameanne et hagger hazze over bishlosha lavin mishshum <small>(Vayikra 25 17)</small> "velo tonu ish et amito" umishshum <small>(Shemot 22 20)</small> "veger lo tone" umishshum lo tonennu. vechen over mishshum <small>(Shemot 22 20)</small> "velo tilchatzennu" kemo shebbearnu beinyan honaya: 
Hakkone eved min haakkum setam velo ratza lamul ulekabbel mitzvot haavadim megalgelin immo kol shenem asar chodesh veim lo ratza chozer umochro leakkum o lechutza laaretz. veim hitna haeved alav techilla shello yamul hare ze muttar lekayyemo kol zeman sheyyirtze begeuto umochro leakkum o lechutza laaretz. vechen eved shemmal vetaval leshem avdut veachar kach hippil atzmo ligyasot veen rabbo yachol lehotzio lo bedine yisrael velo bedine ummot haolam hare ze muttar lo littol damav min haakkum vechotev umaale bearkaot shel akkum mippene shehu kematztzil miyyadam: 
Hammafkir avdo yatza lecherut vetzarich get shichrur. veim met haadon shehifkiro hayyoresh kotev lo get shichrur: 
Eved shebbarach mibbet haasurin im nityaesh mimmennu rabbo yatza lecherut vechofin et rabbo vechotev lo get shichrur: 
Eved shennishba im nityaesh mimmennu rabbo rishon kol happode oto leshem eved yishtabed bo vahare hu shello. veim padahu leshem ben chorin hare ze ben chorin. veim lo nityaesh mimmennu rabbo rishon happode oto leshem eved notel pidyono merabbo vechozer lerabbo. veim padahu leshem ben chorin chozer lerabbo harishon belo kelum: 
Eved sheasao rabbo appoteke levaal chovo veshichrero hare ze meshuchrar vechofin et baal chovo leshachrero. gam ze mippene tikkun haolam shello yifga bo leachar zeman veyomar lo avdi atta: 
Eved shehissio rabbo bat chorin o shehinniach lo rabbo tefillin berosho o sheamar lo rabbo likrot shelosha pesukin besefer tora bifne tzibbur. vechen kol kayyotze beellu haddevarim sheeno chayyav bahen ella ben chorin yetze lecherut vechofin et rabbo lichtov lo get shichrur. vechen im nadar neder shekkofin alav et haavadim kemo shebbearnu bindarim veamar lo rabbo mufar lecha yetze lecherut shekkevan shello kafa oto bemakom sheyyesh lo lichpoto gilla dato shehifkia shibudo. mikkan ani omer shehameshachrer avdo bechol lashon vehotzi devarim mippiv shemmashmaan shello nishar lo alav shibud kelal vesheggamar belibbo ledavar ze sheeno yachol lachzor bo kofin oto lichtov lo get shichrur af al pi sheadayin lo katav. aval im lava meavdo o sheasahu appotroppos o shehinniach tefillin bifne rabbo o shekkara shelosha pesukim bevet hakkeneset bifne rabbo velo micha bo lo yetze lecherut: 
Veasur leadam lelammed et avdo tora veim limmedo lo yatza lecherut: 
Hallokeach eved min haakkum vekadam haeved vetaval bifne rabbo leshem ben chorin yatza lecherut. shello bifne rabbo tzarich lefaresh lefichach tzarich rabbo letakpo bammayim: 
Yisrael shettakaf akkum katan o matza tinok akkum vehitbilo leshem ger hare ze ger. leshem eved hare ze eved. leshem ben chorin hare ze ben chorin: 
Ger shekkadmu avadav veshifchotav vetavlu lefanav kanu atzman bene chorin:
Mishneh Torah, Slaves 9:
Yisrael shebba al shifcha kenaanit af al pi shehi shifchato hare ze havvalad kenaani lechol davar venimkar venikne umishtammeshim bo leolam kishar haavadim: 
Echad hakkone eved kenaani miyyisrael o min ger toshav o min akkum shehu kavush tachat yadenu o meechad mishshear haummot yesh lo limkor et atzmo leyisrael leeved vahare hu eved kenaani lechol davar. vechen mocher banav uvenotav shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 45)</small> "mehem tiknu umimmishpachtam asher immachem asher holidu beartzechem". vechol echad meellu hare hu keeved kenaani lechol davar: 
Echad min haummot shebba al shifcha kenaanit shellanu hare habben eved kenaani shenneemar asher holidu beartzechem. aval haeved shellanu shebba al achat min haummot en habben eved shenneemar asher holidu beartzechem veeved en lo yachas: 
Melech akkum sheasa milchama vehevi shivya umecharah. vechen im hirsha lechol mi sheyyirtze sheyyelech veyignov meumma shehi osa immo milchama sheyyavi veyimkor leatzmo. vechen im hayu dinav shekkol mi shello yitten hammas yimkor. o mi sheasa kach vechach o lo yaase yimkor. hare dinav din veeved hannilkach bedinin ellu hare hu keeved kenaani lechol davar: 
Akkum shekkana akkum leavdut lo kana gufo veen lo bo ella maase yadav. af al pi chen im mecharo leyisrael hare gufo kanuy leyisrael: 
Haishsha kona shefachot veenah kona avadim afillu ketannim mippene hachashad veim kanta otam hare zo kanta gufam keish. veyerae li sheenah asura liknot ella eved ben tesha shanim umittesha ulemala. vechen asur leadam leshachrer eved kenaani. vechol hameshachrero over baase shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 46)</small> "lelam bahem taavodu". veim shichrero meshuchrar kemo shebbearnu. vechofin oto lichtov get shichrur bechol hadderachim shebbearnu. umuttar leshachrero lidvar mitzva afillu lemitzva shel divrehem kegon shello hayu asara bevet hakkeneset hare ze meshachrer avdo umashlim bo hamminyan. vechen kol kayyotze baze. vechen shifcha shennohagin bah haam minhag hefker vahare hi michshol lachotim kofin et rabba umeshachrerah kede shettinnase veyasur hammichshol. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Yachol harav lomar leavdo kenaani asa immi veeni zancha ella yelech veyishal al happetachim veyitparnes min hatztzedaka sheyyisrael metzuvvin lehachayot haavadim shebbenehem. bamme devarim amurim baavadav sheen bet din nizkakin ligdolim lishmor mamonam veim lo yaachil laavadav veyashkem karauy hem yivrechu o yamutu veadam chas al mamon atzmo yeter mikkol adam. aval avadim shehichnisa lo ishto betorat nichse melog chayyav bimzonotehen sheal menat ken hichnis otam sheim lo yazun otam yamutu veyivrechu vahare eno chayyav beacharayutan: 
Muttar laavod beeved kenaani befarech. veaf al pi shehaddin kach middat chasidut vedarche chachma sheyyihye adam rachman verodef tzedek velo yachbid ello al avdo velo yatzer lo veyaachilehu veyashkehu mikkol maachol umikkol mishte. chachamim harishonim hayu notnin laeved mikkol tavshil vetavshil shehayu ochlin. umakdimin mezon habbehemot vehaavadim lisudat atzman. hare hu omer <small>(Tehillim 123 2)</small> "cheene avadim el yad adonehem keene shifcha el yad gevirtah". vechen lo yevazzehu bayyad velo bidvarim. leavdut mesaran hakkatuv lo levusha. velo yarbe alav tzeaka vechaas ella yedabber immo benachat veyishma taanotav. vechen meforash bedarche iyyov hattovim shehishtabbeach bahen <small>(Iyov lo 13)</small> "im emas mishpat avdi vaamati berivam immadi" <small>(Iyov lo 15)</small> "halo vabbeten oshoni asahu vaychunennu barechem echad". veen haachzariyyut vehaazzut metzuya ella beakkum ovde avoda zara aval zaro shel avraham avinu vehem yisrael shehishpia lahem hakkadosh baruch hu tovat hattora vetzivva otam bechukkim umishpatim tzaddikim rachmanim hem al hakkol. vechen bemiddotav shel hakkadosh baruch hu shetztzivvanu lehiddamot bahem hu omer <small>(Tehillim 145 9)</small> "verachamav al kol maasav". vechol hamerachem merachamin alav shenneemar <small>(Devarim 13 18)</small> "venatan lecha rachamim verichamcha vehirbecha":
Mishneh Torah, Hiring 1:
Arbaa shomrim neemru battora ushelosha dinin yesh lahem. veellu hen haarbaa shomrin. shomer chinnam. vehashshoel. venose sachar. vehassocher: 
Veellu hen shelosha dinin shellahen. shomer chinnam shennignav happikkadon mimmennu o avad veen tzarich lomar im neenas happikkadon ones gadol kegon shehayta behema umeta o nishbet hare ze nishba sheshshamar kederech hashshomrin ufatur shenneemar <small>(Shemot 22 6)</small> "vegunnav mibbet haish" vegomer <small>(Shemot 22 7)</small> "venikrav baal habbayit el haelohim". hashshoel meshallem hakkol ben sheavad davar hashshaul o nignav ben sheero ones gadol mizze kegon shemmeta habbehema hashsheula o nishbera o nishbet shekkach katuv beshoel <small>(Shemot 22 13)</small> "venishbar o met bealav en immo shallem yeshallem". nose sachar o hassocher shenehem din echad yesh lahen im nignav o avad haddavar hassachur o shennatal sachar al shemirato hare ellu meshallemim. veim ero ones gadol mizze kegon shehayta behema umeta o nishbera o nishbet o nitrefa hare ellu nishbain shenneensa ufeturin shenneemar <small>(Shemot 22 9)</small> "umet o nishbar o nishba en roe" <small>(Shemot 22 10)</small> "shevuat Adonai" vegomer uchetiv <small>(Shemot 22 11)</small> "im ganov yigganev meimmo yeshallem livalav" vegomer. nimtzeta omer shomer chinnam nishba al hakkol. vehashshoel meshallem et hakkol chutz min hammeta bishat melacha kemo sheyyitbaer. nose sachar vehassocher meshallemin et haaveda veet haggeneva venishbain al hoonasin haggedolim kegon shevura ushevuya umeta uterefa. o sheavad haddavar bisfina shettava bayyam o nilkach belistim mezuyyan vechol kayyotze beellu mishshear onasin haggedolim: 
Hammafkid etzel chavero ben bechinnam ben besachar o hishilo o hiskiro im shaal hashshomer et habbealim im haddavar shellahen o secharan hare hashshomer patur mikkelum. afillu pasha baddavar sheshshamar veavad mechamat happeshia hare ze patur shenneemar <small>(Shemot 22 14)</small> "im bealav immo lo yeshallem im sachir hu ba bischaro". bamme devarim amurim kesheshshaal habbealim o secharan beet shennatal hachefetz af al pi sheen habbealim sham immo beet haggeneva vehaaveda o beet shenneenas. aval natal hachefetz venaasa alav shomer techilla veachar kach sachar habbealim o shealan af al pi shehayu habbealim omdin sham beet shenneenas haddavar hashshamur hare ze meshallem shenneemar <small>(Shemot 22 13)</small> "bealav en immo shallem yeshallem" mippi hashshemua lamdu haya immo bishat hasheala af al pi sheeno beet haggeneva vehammita patur lo haya immo bishat hasheala af al pi shehaya immo beet hammita o hashsheviyya chayyav. vehu haddin lishar hashshomrim shekkullan bivalim peturin afillu peshia bivalim patur: 
Kol shomer sheppasha bitchillato af al pi shenneenas besofo chayyav kemo sheyyitbaer. veen hashshoel rashshay lehasheil afillu shaal sefer tora shekkol shekkore bo ose mitzva lo yashilennu leacher. vechen en hassocher rashshay lehasekir afillu hiskiro sefer tora lo yaskirennu leacher shehare ze omer lo en retzoni sheyyihye pikdoni beyad acher. avar hashshomer umasar lashshomer hashsheni im yesh edim sheshshemarah hashshomer hashsheni kederech hashshomrin veneenas patur hashshomer harishon shehare yesh edim shenneenas. veim en sham edim chayyav hashshomer harishon leshallem labbealim mippene shemmasar leshomer acher veyaase hu din im hashshomer hashsheni. afillu haya harishon shomer chinnam umasar leshomer sachar chayyav shehare yesh levaal hachefetz lomar lo atta neeman etzli lehishshava veze eno neeman. lefichach im haya derech habbealim lehafekid tamid davar ze etzel hashshomer hashsheni hare ze hashshomer harishon patur milleshallem shehare hu omer labbealim ze haddavar shehifkadtem etzli o hishaltem emesh heyitem mafkidin oto etzel ze shehifkadti ani etzlo. vehu shello yemaet shemirato. ketzad yemaet shemirato. kegon shehaya mufkad etzlo besachar vehifkido etzel oto hashsheni bechinnam o shehaya shaul etzlo vehifkido etzel oto hashsheni besachar hoil umiet shemirato poshea hu umeshallem. af al pi sheshshaal o shessachar babbealim hare hu hotzi haddavar hashshamur miyyado leyad shomer acher: 
Veim hevi hashshomer hashsheni haraya sheyyippater bah shomer rishon kedin shemirato hare ze patur. ketzad. shomer sachar shennatan habbehema hashshemura etzlo leshomer chinnam im hevi hashshomer hashsheni edim shemmeta habbehema kedarkah hare hashshomer harishon patur. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Shomer shemmasar leshomer acher vehosif bishmirato umeta hahanaa labbealim. ketzad. hassocher para mechavero vehishilah leacher umeta kedarkah beyad hashshoel hoil vehashshoel chayyav bakkol yachziru deme happara labbealim sheen ze hassocher ose sechora befarato shel chavero. vechen kol kayyotze baze. haya beyado pikkadon ushelacho beyad acher livalav hoil vehashshomer harishon chayyav beacharayuto ad sheyyaggia leyad habbealim im ba lachzor ulehachzir happikkadon miyyad hashshomer hashsheni machzir. veim huchzak hashshomer harishon kafran eno yachol lehachezir happikkadon miyyad hashshomer hashsheni af al pi sheadayin happikkadon beacharayuto shel rishon:
Mishneh Torah, Hiring 2:
Shelosha dinin haamurin battora bearbaa hashshomrin enan ella bemittaltelin shel yisrael veshel hedyot shenneemar <small>(Shemot 22 6)</small> "kesef o chelim" <small>(Shemot 22 9)</small> "vechol behema" yatzu karkaot veyatzu haavadim shehukkeshu lekarkaot veyatzu hashshetarot sheen gufan mamon veyatzu hekdeshot shenneemar <small>(Shemot 22 6)</small> "ki yitten ish el reehu" veyatzu nichse akkum. mikkan amru chachamim haavadim vehashshetarot vehakkarkaot vehahekdeshot shomer chinnam shellahen eno nishba. venose sachar o socher eno meshallem. veim kanu miyyado chayyav beacharayutan: 
Vetikkenu chachamim shennishbain al hahekdeshot shevuat hashshomrin keen shel tora kede shello yezalzelu bahekdeshot: 
Yerae li sheim pasha hashshomer baavadim vechayyotze bahen chayyav leshallem. sheeno patur baavadim vekarkaot ushetarot ella middin geneva vaaveda umeta vechayyotze bahen. sheim haya shomer chinnam al mittaltelin venignevu o avdu yishshava uvaavadim vekarkaot ushetarot patur mishshevua. vechen im haya shomer sachar shemmeshallem geneva vaaveda bemittaltelin patur milleshallem beellu. aval im pasha bah chayyav leshallem shekkol happoshea mazzik hu. veen hefresh ben din hammazzik karka ledin hammazzik mittaltelin. vedin emet hu ze lammevinim vechen rauy ladun. vechen horu rabbotay shehammoser karmo leshomer ben baarisut ben bishmirut chinnam vehitna immo sheyyachpor o yizmor o yeabbek mishshello ufasha velo asa chayyav kemi shehifsid bayyadayim. vechen kol kayyotze baze shehifsid bayyadayim chayyav al kol panim: 
Hammoser lachavero davar hamechubbar lakkarka lishmor afillu hayu anavim haomdot lehibbatzer hare hen kekarka bedin hashshomrin: 
Hifkid hekdesh veachar kach padahu vahare hu chullin beet shennetalo miyyad hashshomer. o shehishilo chullin veachar kach hikdish vehu beyad hashshoel. vechen akkum shehifkid veachar kach nitgayyer. kol ellu en bahen kol dine hashshomrin ad shettihye techillatan vesofan nichse hedyot venichse yisrael: 
Echad haish veechad haishsha bedin hashshomrin ben shehaya haddavar hashshamur shel ishsha o shehaya beyad haishsha: 
Katan shehifkid beyad gadol o hishilo hare ze haggadol nishba shevuat hashshomrim lakkatan. horu rabbotay sheen ze nishba betaanat hakkatan kede shennomar en nishbain al taanat katan shekkol hashshomrin shevuatan shevuat shemma hi: 
Kederech shettikkenu chachamim meshicha belakochot kach tikkenu meshicha beshomrin. haomer lachavero shemor li ze veamar lo hannach lefanay hare ze shomer chinnam. amar lo hannach lefanecha o hannach setam o sheamar lo hare habbayit lefanecha eno lo shomer chinnam velo shomer sachar veeno chayyav shevua kelal aval macharim al mi shellakach happikkadon shello velo yachaziro livalav. vechen kol kayyotze baze. echad hammafkid o hammashil o hammaskir et chavero beedim o shello beedim din echad yesh lahen kevan shehoda ze mippi atzmo sheshshamar lo o sheshshaal mimmennu hare ze nishba shevuat hashshomrin sheen omrim miggo lefatro mishshevua ella lefatro milleshallem. afillu haya haddavar hashshaul o hammufkad o hammuskar sheve peruta hare ze hashshomer nishba alav. veen echad min hashshomrim tzarich lehodaya bemiktzat: 
Matne shomer chinnam lihyot patur mishshevua vehashshoel lihyot patur milleshallem. vechen matne baal happikkadon al shomer chinnam o nose sachar vesocher lihyot chayyavin bakkol keshoel. shekkol tenay bemamon o bishvuot shel mamon kayyam veen tzarich kinyan velo edim: 
Taan ze shehaya sham tenay vehashshomer omer lo haya sham tenay nishba hashshomer shevuat hashshomrin umegalgel bah shello haya sham tenay: 
Taan shehifkid etzlo veze omer lo amarti ella hannach lefanecha velo naaseti lo shomer nishba hesset shello kibbelo ella bederech zo vecholel bishvuato shello shalach bo yad velo ibbedo bayyadayim velo bigram sheggaram lo sheyyihye chayyav leshallem: 
Ze omer hishalticha o hiskarticha o hifkadticha vehalla omer lo hayu devarim meolam. o sheamar ken haya aval hechezarti lecha venistalleka hashshemira velo nishara benenu tevia. hare hannitba nishba shevuat hesset veniftar. bamme devarim amurim keshello haya sham shetar. aval im hifkid o hiskir o hishil bishtar veamar lo hechzarti lecha hare hashshomer nishba binkitat chefetz mittoch sheyyachol lomar shomer chinnam shennignav o avad vehashshoel meta bishat melacha neeman lomar hechzarti. ucheshem sheim taan shenneenas nishba min hattora binkitat chefetz kach im taan hechezarti yishshava keen shel tora hoil veyesh sham shetar beyad hattovea. bamme devarim amurim keshehaya hashshomer yachol liton velomar neensu velo natzrich oto lehavi reaya al taanato. aval im haya chayyav lehavi reaya al taanato kemo sheyyitbaer eno neeman lomar hechzarti ella yishshava baal hashshetar binkitat chefetz shello hechzir lo vishallem. en lecha mi shennishba mittoch sheyyachol lomar kach vechach veyishshava binkitat chefetz ella ze hashshomer bilvad sheyyesh alav shetar aval shear kol hannishbain baddin mittoch sheyyachol lomar enan nishbain ella hesset:
Mishneh Torah, Hiring 3: Shomer shettaan shenneenas ones gadol kegon shevura umeta. im neenas bemakom shehaedim metzuyin sham matzrichin oto reaya al taanato shenneenas veyippater af mishshevuat shomrim veim lo hevi reaya yeshallem shenneemar <small>(Shemot 22 9)</small> "en roe" <small>(Shemot 22 10)</small> "shevuat Adonai tihye ben shenehem" ha bemakom sheefshar lehavi reaya en sham shevua ella o yavi reaya o yeshallem. aval im taan shenneenas bemakom sheen haedim metzuyin sham en matzrichin oto reaya ella yishshava shenneenas veyippater. veim hevi edim shello pasha bah niftar af min hashshevua. maase beechad shehevi chavit shel yayin besachar ushevarah bashshuk shel mechoza uvau lifne chachamim veamru shuk ze shettaanta shennishbera bo chavit bene adam metzuyin sham o tavi reaya shello pashata ella nitkalta venafalta o teshallem dameha. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Hammaavir chavit mimmakom lemakom besachar venishbera din tora hu sheyyeshallem sheen ze ones gadol vahare hashshevira kigneva vaaveda shehu chayyav bahen. aval tikkenu chachamim sheyyihye chayyav shevua shello pasha bah sheim atta omer yeshallem en lecha adam sheyyaavir chavit lachavero lefichach asu bo shevirat hechavit kemitat habbehema usheviratah. veod tikkenu bedavar ze sheim nasu otah shenayim bemot venishbera meshallemin chatzi dameha hoil umassoy ze gadol legabbe echad vekal legabbe shenayim hare hu keones veeno ones umeshallemin mechetza im yesh edim shello pashu bah. nishbera bemakom sheen haedim metzuyin nishbain shello shevaruha bifshia umeshallemin chatzi dameha. shehare lo haya lechol echad lehaavir ella massoy sheyyachol lehaaviro bifne atzmo. mikkan atta lamed shehaechad sheheevir chavit gedola sheen derech kol hassabbalim lehaavirah shehu poshea veim nishbera beyado meshallem hakkol:

Hassabbal sheshshavar chavit shel yayin lechenvani venitchayyev leshallem vahare hi shava beyom hashshuk arbaa uvishar hayyamim shelosha im hechziro beyom hashshuk chayyavin lehachezir chavit shel yayin o yeshallemu lo arbaa vehu shello haya lo yayin limkor beyom hashshuk aval im haya lo yayin machazirin lo shelosha. hechziru lo bishar hayyamim machazirin lo shelosha umenakkin lo bechol zeman torach shehaya toreach bimchiratah ufegam hannekev shehaya nokev hechavit vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Roe shebbau zeevim vetarfu mimmennu im haya zeev echad en ze ones afillu bishat mishlachat zeevim. veim hayu shene zeevim hare ze ones. shene kelavim enan ones afillu bau mishshete ruchot. hayu yeter al shenayim hare ze ones. listim mezuyyan hare hu ones vaafillu haya haroe mezuyyan uva lo listim acher mezuyyan hare ze ones sheen haroe moser nafsho kelistim. haari vehaddov vehannamer vehabbardelas vehannachash hare ellu onasin. ematay bizman shebbau mealehen. aval im holicham limkom gedude chayyot velistim en ellu onasin vechayyav leshallem:

Roe shemmatza gannav vehitchil lehitgarot bo uleharoto sheeno choshesh mimmennu veamar lo hare anu bemakom peloni vechach vechach roim anachnu vechach vechach kele milchama yesh lanu uva oto hallistim venitztzecho velakach mehen hare haroe chayyav sheechad hammolich et habbehema limkom gedude chayyot velistim o mevi et hallistim behitgaruto limkom habbehema:

Roe shehaya lo lehatztzil hatterefa o hashshevuya beroim acherim uvemaklot velo kara roim acherim velo hevi maklot lehatztzil hare ze chayyav echad shomer chinnam veechad shomer sachar ella sheshshomer chinnam kore roim umevi maklot bechinnam veim lo matza patur aval shomer sachar chayyav liskor haroim vehammaklot ad kede deme habbehema kede lehatztzil vechozer velokeach secharan mibbaal habbayit. veim lo asa chen vehaya lo liskor velo sachar hare ze poshea vechayyav:

Roe shettaan shehitztzalti al yede roim besachar nishba venotel ma shettaan sheeno yachol liton ella ad kede demehen veyachol haya lomar nitrefa veyishshava binkitat chefetz kedin kol hannishbain venotlin:

Roe shehinniach edro uva lair ben beet shedderech haroim lehikkanes uven beet sheen derech haroim lehikkanes uvau zeevim uterafo ari vedaras en omrim illu haya sham haya matztzil ella omdin oto im yachol lehatztzil al yede roim umaklot chayyav veim lav patur veim en haddavar yadua chayyav leshallem:

Meta habbehema kedarkah hare ze ones veharoe patur. sigfah umeta eno ones. tekafattu vealta lerashe tzukin utekafattu venafla hare ze ones. heelah lerashe tzukin o shealta meeleha vehu yachol lemanah velo menaah af al pi shettekafattu venafla umeta o nishbera chayyav shekkol shettechillato bifshia vesofo beones chayyav. vechen roe sheheevir habbehemot al haggesher vedachafa achat mehen lachavertah venafla leshibbolet hannahar hare ze chayyav shehaya lo lehaaviran achat achat sheen hashshomer notel sachar ella lishmor shemira meella vehoil ufasha battechilla veheeviran keechad af al pi shenneenas bassof beet hannefila hare hu chayyav:

Pasha bah veyatza laagam umeta sham kedarkah patur sheen yetziatah garma lah shettavo lide ones ze hoil uchedarkah meta ma li bevet shomer ma li baagam. aval im genavah gannav mehaagam umeta kedarkah bevet haggannav hare hashshomer chayyav af al pi shehu shomer chinnam sheafillu lo meta hare hi aveda beyad haggannav vitziatah garma lah lehigganev. vechen kol kayyotze baze:
Mishneh Torah, Hiring 4:
Hasocher et hachamor leholichah bahar veholichah babbika im huchleka patur af al pi sheavar al daat habbealim. veim huchamma chayyav. secharah leholichah babbika veholichah bahar im huchleka chayyav shehachalakut yeter bahar min habbika. veim huchamma patur shechamimut babbika yeter min hahar mippene haruach shemmenashshevet berosh heharim. veim huchamma mechamat hammaala chayyav vechen kol kayyotze baze. vechen hassocher et happara lachrosh bahar vecharash babbika venishbar hakkankan vehu hakkeli shechoresh bo hare hassocher patur vedin baal happara im haummanin shecharshu. vechen im lo shinna al daat habbealim venishbar hakkankan din baal happara im haummanin. secharah lachrosh babbika vecharash bahar venishbar hakkankan hassocher chayyav vedino shel socher im haummanim: 
Umahu din haummanin sheshshavru beet charisha shemmeshallemin. mi meshallem ze haochez et hakkeli beet hacharisha. veim hayta hassade maalot maalot shenehem chayyavim bidme hakkankan. hammanhig otah bemalmad vehaochez et hakkeli: 
Secharah ladush bekitnit vedash bitvua vehuchleka patur bitvua vedash bekitnit chayyav shehakkitnit machleket. maase beechad shehiskir chamor lachavero veamar lo lo telech bo bederech nahar pekod shehammayim metzuyin sham ella bederech neresh sheen bah mayim. halach bederech nahar pekod umet hachamor velo hayu sham edim shemmeidim bee ze derech halach ella hu meatzmo amar benahar pekod halachti velo hayu sham mayim umechamat atzmo met veamru chachamim hoil veyesh edim shehammayim benahar pekod metzuyin chayyav leshallem shehare shinna al daat habbealim veen omrim ma li leshakker bimkom edim: 
Hassocher et habbehema lehavi aleha matayim litrin shel chittim vehevi matayim litrin shel seorim umeta chayyav mippene shehannefach kashe lemassooy vehasseorin yesh lahen nefach. vechen im secharah lehavi tevua vehevi bemishkalah teven. aval im secharah lehavi aleha seorim vehevi bemishkalan chittim umeta patur. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Sachar et habbehema lirkov aleha ish lo yarkiv aleha ishsha. secharah lirkov aleha ishsha markiv aleha ish. umarkiv aleha kol ishsha ben ketanna ben gedola vaafillu meebberet shehi menika: 
Hassocher et habbehema laset aleha mishkal yadua vehosif al massao im hosif chelek mishsheloshim al hashshiur sheppasak immo umeta chayyav pachot mikkan patur aval noten hu sechar hattosefet. sachar setam eno nose ella bemishkal hayyadua bammedina leotah behema. veim hosif chelek mishsheloshim kegon sheddarkah laset sheloshim vetaan aleha sheloshim veechad umeta o nishbera chayyav. vechen sefina shehosif bah echad mishsheloshim al massaah vetava chayyav leshallem dameha: 
Hakkattaf shehosif al massao kav echad huzzak bemassa ze chayyav binzakav. sheaf al pi shehu ben daat vahare hu margish bechoved hammassa yaale al libbo shemma mechamat chalyo hu ze hakkoved: 
Hassocher et hachamor lirkov aleha yesh lo lehanniach aleha kesuto velagino umezonotav shel oto hadderech lefi sheen derech hassocher lachzor bechol malon umalon liknot mezonot. yeter al ze hare meakkev alav baal hachamor. vechen yesh levaal hachamor lehanniach aleha seorim veteven umezonot shel oto hayyom yeter al ze hassocher meakkev mippene sheefshar lo liknot bechol malon umalon. lefichach im en sham meayin yikne manniach alav mezonotav umezonot behemto shel kol otah hadderech. vechol ellu haddevarim besocher setam uvemakom sheen minhag yadua. aval bemakom sheyyesh minhag hakkol lefi hamminhag:
Mishneh Torah, Hiring 5: Hassocher et habbehema vechalta o nishtottet o nilkecha laavodat hammelech af al pi sheen sofah lachzor im nilkecha derech halicha hare hammaskir omer lassocher hare shellecha lefanecha vechayyav litten lo secharo mishshalem. bamme devarim amurim beshessecharah laset aleha massoy sheefshar lehashelicho belo hakepada aval im secharah lirkov aleha o laset aleha kele zechuchit vechayyotze bahen chayyav lehaamid lo chamor acher im sachar mimmennu chamor veim lo heemid yachzir hassachar veyachshov immo al sachar kamma shehalach bah:

Meta habbehema o nishbera ben shessecharah laset ben shessecharah lirkov im amar lo chamor setam ani maskir lecha chayyav lehaamid lo chamor acher mikkol makom. veim lo heemid yesh lassocher limkor habbehema velikkach bah behema acheret o socher behema bedameha im en bedameha likkach ad sheyyaggia lemakom sheppasak bo. amar lo chamor ze ani socher lecha im secharah lirkov aleha o lichle zechuchit umeta bachatzi hadderech im yesh bedameha likkach behema acheret yikkach veim en bedameha likkach socher afillu bidme kullah ad sheyyaggia lammakom sheppasak immo. veim en bedameha lo likkach velo liskor noten lo secharo shel chatzi hadderech veen lo alav ella taromet. secharah lemassa hoil veamar lo chamor ze umet bachatzi hadderech eno chayyav lehaamid lo acher ella noten lo secharo shel chatzi hadderech umanniach lo nivlato:

Hassocher et hassefina vtava lo bachatzi hadderech. im amar lo sefina zo ani maskir lecha usecharah hassocher leholich bah yayin setam af al pi shennatan lo hassachar yachzir kol hassachar shehare ze omer lo have li hassefina atzmah shessacharti shehakepada gedola yesh bisfina zo vaani avi yayin mikkol makom veolich bah. amar lo sefina setam ani maskir lecha usecharah hassocher leholich bah yayin ze af al pi shello natan lo min hassachar kelum chayyav litten kol hassachar. shehare omer lo have li hayyayin atzmo vaani avi lecha sefina mikkol makom veolicho. aval tzarich lenakkot kede hattorach shel chatzi hadderech sheeno dome hametappel beholachat hassefina leyoshev uvatel. amar lo sefina zo ani maskir vesachar hassocher leholich bah yayin ze im natan hassachar eno yachol lehacheziro veim lo natan lo yitten sheen ze yachol lehavi hassefina atzmah velo ze yachol lehavi yayin atzmo. sachar sefina setam leyayin setam hare ellu cholkin hassachar:

Hassocher et hassefina ufarka bachatzi hadderech noten lo sechar kol hadderech veim matza hassocher mi sheyyaskir otah lo ad hammakom sheppasak socher veyesh levaal hassefina alav taromet. vechen im machar kol hassechora shebbassefina leish acher bachatzi hadderech veyarad veala hallokeach notel sechar chatzi hadderech min harishon usechar hachetzi mizze haacharon veyesh levaal hassefina alav taromet sheggaram lo lisbol daat ish acher sheadayin lo hurgal bo. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Mikkan ani omer shehammaskir bayit lachavero ad zeman katzuv veratza hassocher lehasekir habbayit leacher ad sof zemanno maskir laacherim im yesh bene bayit keminyan bene beto. aval im hayu arbaa lo yiskor lachamishsha. shello amru chachamim en hassocher rashshay lehasekir ella mittaltelin shehare omer lo en retzoni sheyyehe pikdoni beyad acher aval bekarka o bisfina shehare balah immah en omer ken. vechen ani omer im amar lo baal habbayit lassocher lamma titrach vetaskir beti laacherim im lo tirtze laamod bo tze hannicho veatta patur missechirato eno yachol lehasekiro leacher shezze beal timna tov mibbealav ad sheatta maskiro leacher tanniach laze beto. veyesh mi shehora sheeno yachol lehasekiro leacher kelal veyitten secharo ad sof zemanno velo yerae li sheddin ze emet:

Bayit ze ani maskir lecha veachar shehiskiro nafal eno chayyav livnoto ella mechashshev al ma shennishtammesh bo umachazir lo shear hassechirut. aval im setaro chayyav lehaamid lo bayit acher o yaskir lo kemoto. vechen im chazar achar shehiskiro laze vehiskiro o mecharo leakkum o annas shehifkia sechirut harishon hare ze chayyav lehasekir lo bayit acher kemoto. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Hiskir lo bayit setam veachar shennatan lo bayit nafal chayyav livnoto o yitten lo bayit acher. veim haya katan min habbayit shennafal en hassocher yachol leakkev alav. vehu sheyyihye karuy bayit shello hiskir ella bayit setam. aval im amar lo bayit kaze ani maskir lecha chayyav lehaamid lo bayit kemiddat arko umiddat rachbo shel bayit ze sheherahu. veeno yachol lomar lo lo haya inyan devaray ella sheyyihye karov lannahar o lashshuk o lammerchatz kaze ella chayyav lehaamid lo bayit kemiddato uchetzurato lefichach im haya katan lo yaasennu gadol gadol lo yaasennu katan echad lo yaasennu shenayim shenayim lo yaasennu echad. velo yifchot min hachallonot shehayu bo velo yosif alehen ella middaat shenehem:

Hammaskir aliyya setam chayyav lehaamid lo aliyya. amar lo aliyya zo sheal gabbe bayit ze ani maskir lecha hare shibed bayit laaliyya lefichach im nifchata haaliyya bearbaa tefachim o yeter chayyav hammaskir letakken veim lo tikken hare hassocher yored vedar babbayit im baal habbayit ad sheyyetakken. hayu shete aliyyot zo al gabbe zo venifchata haelyona dar battachtona. nifchata hattachtona hare ze safek im yadur baelyona o babbayit lefichach lo yadur veim dar en motziin oto mishsham. maase beechad sheamar lachavero dallit zo sheal gabbe happarsek hazze ani maskir lecha veneekar ilan happarsek mimmekomo uva maase lifne chachamim veamru lo chayyav atta lehaamid happarsek kol zeman shehaddallit kayyemet. vechen kol kayyotze baze:
Mishneh Torah, Hiring 6:
Hammaskir bayit lachavero bevira gedola mishtammesh bezizeha uvichtaleha ad arba ammot uvetarbatz shel chatzer uvarchava sheachore habbattim. umakom shennahagu lehishtammesh boovi hakketalim mishtammesh boovi hakketalim. uvechol ellu haddevarim holchin achar minhag hammedina vehashshemot hayeduin lahem kederech sheamarnu beinyan mikkach umimkar: 
Hammaskir chatzero setam lo hiskir harefet shebbah: 
Hammaskir bayit lachavero chayyav lehaamid lo delatot veliftoach lo hachallonot shennitkalkelu ulechazzek et hattikra velismoch et hakkora shennishbera velaasot neger umanul vechol kayyotze beellu middevarim shehen maase umman vehem ikkar gadol bishivat habbattim vehachatzerot. hassocher chayyav laasot maake umezuza uletakken mekom hammezuza mishshello. vechen im ratza laasot sullam o marzev o lehatiach gaggo hare ze ose mishshel atzmo: 
Hammaskir aliyya lachavero venifchata bearbaa o yeter chayyav letakken hattikra vehammaaziva shealeha shehammaaziva chizzuk hattikra hi: 
Hazzevel shebbechatzer hare hu shel socher lefichach hu metappel bo lehotzio veim yesh sham minhag holchin acher hamminhag. bamme devarim amurim keshehayu habbehemot sheasu hazzevel shel socher aval im habbehemot shel acherim hazzevel shel baal hechatzer shechatzero shel adam kona shello middato af al pi shehi sechura beyad acherim: 
Hammaskir bayit o chatzer o merchatz o chanut o shear hammekomot ad zeman katzuv hare ze kofehu latzet besof zemanno veeno mamtin lo afillu shaa achat. sachar lo bayit setam lelina en pachot miyyom echad. lishvita en pachot mishshene yamim. lenissuin en pachot mishsheloshim yom: 
Hammaskir bayit lachavero setam eno yachol lehotzio ad sheyyodio sheloshim yom mikkodem kede levakkesh makom velo yihye mushlach badderech ulesof hashsheloshim yetze. bamme devarim amurim bimot hachamma aval bimot haggeshamim eno yachol lehotzio min hechag vead happesach. kava lo sheloshim lifne hechag im nishar min hashsheloshim yom afillu yom echad leachar hechag eno yachol lehotzio ad motzae happesach vehu sheyyodio sheloshim yom mikkodem. bamme devarim amurim baayarot aval bakkerakkim echad yemot hachamma veechad yemot haggeshamim tzarich lehodio shenem asar chodesh mikkodem. vechen bachanut ben bakkerakkim ben baayarot tzarich lehodio shenem asar chodesh mikkodem: 
Keshem shehammaskir chayyav lehodio kach hassocher chayyav lehodio mikkodem sheloshim yom baayarot o mikkodem shenem asar chodesh bakkerakkim kede sheyyevakkesh shachen velo yishshaer beto panuy. veim lo hodio eno yachol latzet ella yitten hassachar: 
Af al pi sheen hammaskir yachol lehotzio velo hassocher yachol latzet ad sheyyodio mikkodem. im hukeru habbattim yesh lammaskir lehosif alav velomar lassocher o sechor beshave ad shettimtza o tetze. vechen im huzelu habbattim yesh lassocher lifchot hassachar velomar lammaskir o haseker li keshaar shel atta o hare betcha lefanecha. nafal bet hammaskir shehaya dar bo hare ze yesh lo lehotzi hassocher mibbeto veomer lo eno bedin shettihye atta yoshev beveti ad shettimtza makom vaani mushlach bederech sheen atta baal zechut bevayit ze yoter mimmenni: 
Natan habbayit livno lissa bo ishsha im haya yodea shebbeno naasa chatan bizman peloni vehaya efshar lo lehodio mikkodem velo hodio eno yachol lehotzio. veim achshav nizdammena lo ishsha vahare hu nosah miyyad hare ze yesh lo lehotzio sheeno bedin sheyyihye ze yoshev beveto uven baal habbayit yiskor bayit sheyyaase bo chatunna: 
Machar et habbayit o netano o horisho en hashsheni yachol lehotzio ad sheyyodio mikkodem sheloshim yom o mikkodem shenem asar chodesh. shehare hassocher omer lo en kochacha yeter mikkoach ze shezzachita bevayit ze mechamato:
Mishneh Torah, Hiring 7:
Keshem shemmatne adam kol tenay sheyyirtze bemikkach umimkar kach matne bischirut shehassechirut mechira lizman katzuv hi vechol shemmimkaro binchasav mimkar socher sechiruto sechirut. vechol sheen lo limkor kach en lo liskor ella im ken yesh lo perot bilvad beotah hakkarka hare ze socher veeno mocher: 
Hammaskir bayit lachavero leshana venitabbera hashshana nitabbera lassocher. hiskir lechodashim nitabbera lammaskir. hizkir lo chodashim veshana ben sheamar lo dinar lechodesh shenem asar dinar beshana. ben sheamar lo shenem asar dinar leshana dinar bechol chodesh. hare chodesh haibbur shel maskir shehakkarka bechezkat bealim veen motziin davar miyyad baal hakkarka ella biraya berura. vechen baal habbayit sheamar lizman ze hiskarti lecha vehassocher omer lo sacharti ella setam o lizman aroch al hassocher lehavi reaya veim lo hevi baal habbayit nishba hesset umotzio min habbayit: 
Hassocher sheamar natatti sechar habbayit shennitchayyavti bo vehammaskir omer adayin lo natalti ben shehayta bishtar ben shehayta beedim. im tevao betoch sheloshim yom al hassocher lehavi reaya o yitten veyacharim al mi shellakach mimmennu o yiton alav bedamim shennatan techilla taana bifne atzmah veyashbiehu hesset. tevao hammaskir leachar sheloshim yom vaafillu bayyom hashsheloshim al hammaskir lehavi reaya o yishshava hassocher shekkevar natan lo secharo veyippater. vechen im sachar mimmennu uferesh sheyyitten lo hassachar shana beshana utevao betoch hashshana al hassocher lehavi reaya. tevao leachar hashshana vaafillu beyom tisha veesrim beelul al hammaskir lehavi reaya: 
Hammaskir bayit lachavero bishtar leeser shanim veen bo zeman hassocher omer adayin lo avar mizzeman hashshetar ella shana vehammaskir omer kevar avru veshalmu shene hassechirut veshachanta eser shanim. al hassocher lehavi reaya veim lo hevi reaya yishshava hammaskir hesset veyotzio: 
Hassocher pardes o shehaya mashkon beyado leeser shanim veyavesh happardes betoch hazzeman yimmachru etzav veyillakach bahen karka veyochal perotav ad sof zeman sechiruto o zeman hammashkon. veguf hailanot sheyyavshu o niktzetzu shenehen asurin bahen mishshum ribbit hammalve vehallo: 
Shetar hassechirut o shetar hammashkon shekkatuv bah shanim setam. baal happerot omer shalosh uvaal hakkarka omer shetayim vekadam ze hassocher o hammalve veachal happerot hare happerot bechezkat ochlehen ad sheyyavi baal hakkarka reaya. achalah hassocher o hamemashken shalosh shanim vechavash hashshetar veamar lechamesh shanim yesh li perot uvaal hakkarka omer shalosh amru lo have shetarcha veamar avad hassocher neeman sheillu ratza amar lekucha hi beyadi shehare achalah shalosh shanim:
