Neshech umarbit echad hu shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 37)</small> "et kaspecha lo titten lo beneshech uvemarbit lo titten achlecha" ulehallan hu omer <small>(Devarim 23 20)</small> "neshech kesef neshech ochel neshech kol davar asher yishshach". velamma nikra shemo neshech mippene shehu noshech shemmetzaer et chavero veochel et besaro. velamma chillekan hakkatuv laavor alav bishne lavin: 
Kederech sheasur lehalevot kach asur lilvot beribbit shenneemar <small>(Devarim 23 20)</small> "lo tashshich leachicha" mippi hashshemua lamdu shezzo azhara lallo kelomar lo tinshoch leachich. vechen asur lehitassek ben lo umalve beribbit. vechol mi shehaya arev o sofer o ed benehen hare ze over belo taase. shenneemar <small>(Shemot 22 24)</small> "lo tesimun alav neshech" zo azhara af laedim velaarev velassofer. ha lamadta shehammalve beribbit over al shishsha lavin. <small>(Shemot 22 24)</small> "lo tihye lo kenshe". <small>(Vayikra 25 37)</small> "et kaspecha lo titten lo beneshech". <small>(Vayikra 25 37)</small> "uvemarbit lo titten achlecha". <small>(Vayikra 25 36)</small> "al tikkach meitto neshech vetarbit". lo tesimun alav neshech. <small>(Vayikra 19 14)</small> "velifne ivver lo titten michshl". vehallo over bishnayim. lo tashshich leachicha. velifne ivver lo titten michshol. arev veedim vechayyotze bahen en ovrin ella mishshum lo tesimun alav neshech. vechol mi shehaya sarsur ben shenehem o shessiyyea echad mehen o horahu over mishshum lifne ivver lo titten michshol: 
Af al pi shehammalve vehallo ovrin al kol ellu hallavin enan lokin alav mippene shennittan lehishshavon. shekkol hammalve beribbit im hayta ribbit ketzutza shehi asura min hattora hare zo yotza bedayyanin umotziin otah min hammalve umachzirin lallo. veim met hammalve en motziin miyyad habbanim: 
Hinniach lahem avihem maot shel ribbit af al pi shehen yodin shehen shel ribbit enan chayyavim lehachezir. hinniach lahem para vetallit shel ribbit vechol davar hamesuyyam chayyavim lehachezir mippene kevod avihen. bamme devarim amurim kesheasa teshuva velo hispik lehachezir ad shemmet. aval im lo asa teshuva en choshshin lichvodo vaafillu davar hamesuyyam en machazirin: 
Haggazlanin umalve beribbit shehechziru en mekabbelin mehen kede liftoach lahen derech litshuva. vechol hamekabbel mehen en ruach chachamim nocha hemennu. im hayta gezela kayyemet veharibbit davar hamesuyyam vahare hu beatzmo mekabbelin mehen: 
Shetar shekkatuv bo ribbit ben ketzutza ben shel divrehem gove et hakkeren veeno gove et haribbit. kadam vegava hakkol motziin mimmennu haribbit ketzutza. aval avak ribbit shehu middivrehem eno gove min hallo lammalve veen machazirin oto min hammalve lallo: 
Kol hakkotev shetar ribbit hare ze kechotev umeid alav edim shekkafar baAdonai elohe yisrael. vechen kol hallo umalve beribbit benan leven atzman hare hen kechofrim baAdonai elohe yisrael vechafru bitziat mitzrayim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 37)</small> "et kaspecha lo titten lo beneshech" vegomer <small>(Vayikra 25 38)</small> "ani Adonai elohechem asher hotzeti etchem meeretz mitzrayim": 
Asur leadam lehalevot banav uvene beto beribbit. af al pi sheeno makpid umattana hu shennoten lahen hare ze asur shemma yargilem bedavar ze: 
Talmide chachamim shehilvu ze et ze venatan lo yeter al ma shehilva mimmennu hare ze muttar shehaddavar yadua shello natan lo ella mattana shehare hen yodin chomer issur haribbit: 
Hammalve et chavero umatza hallo yoter [o shehechzir lo chovo umatza hammalve yoter] im bichde shehaddaat toa chayyav lehachezir veim lav mattana hu shennatan lo o gezela hayta lo beyado vehivlia lo becheshbon o acher tzivva lehavelia lo. bechamma haddaat toa beechad uvishnayim o bachamishsha o baasara shemma mana chamishsha chamishsha o asara asara. vechen im matza yater minyan hachamishiyyot o minyan haasiriyyot echad echad chayyav lehachezir lo shemma haachadim shehaya mone bahen hachamishiyyot o haasiriyyot nitarvu immahem: 
Hammalve et chavero al hammatbea vechen hakkotev leishto bichtubbatah matbea yadua uferesh mishkalo vehosifu al mishkalo im huzelu happerot mechamat hattosefet menakke lo shiur hattosefet vaafillu hosifu alav kol shehu. veim lo huzelu mechamat hattosefet eno menakke lo ella noten lo mimmatbea hayyotze beotah shaa. bamme devarim amurim beshehosifu alav ad chamishito kegon shehaya mishkalo arbaa vaasao chamishsha aval im hosifu lo yoter al chamishito menakke lo kol hattosefet af al pi shello huzelu happerot. vehu haddin lemalve al hammatbea ufachatu mimmennu: 
Hammalve et chavero al hammatbea venifsal im yachol lehotzio bimdina acheret veyesh lo derech leotah medina noten lo mimmatbea shehilvahu veomer lo lech vehotzio bemakom peloni. veim en lo derech lesham noten lo mimmatbea hayyotze beotah shaa. vechen bichtubba: 
Horu miktzat haggeonim shehallo shemmachal lammalve beribbit shellakach mimmennu o sheatid likkach af al pi shekkanu miyyado shemmachal o natan mattana eno moil kelum shekkol ribbit shebbaolam mechila hi aval hattora lo machala veasra mechila zo ulefichach en hammechila moelet beribbit afillu beribbit shel divrehem. yerae li sheen horaa zo nechona ella meachar sheomrim lammalve lehachezir lo veyada hammalve sheddevar issur asa veyesh lo littol mimmennu im ratza limchol mochel kederech shemmochel haggezel. uveferush amru chachamim shehaggazlanin umalve beribbit shehechziru en mekabbelin mehen mikkelal shehammechila moelet: 
Nichse yetomim muttar litten otam leadam neeman sheyyesh lo nechasim tovim karov lesachar verachok lehefsed. ketzad. omer lo tihye nose venoten bahen im yesh sham revach ten lahem chelkan min harevach veim yesh sham hefsed tafsid atta levaddecha shezze avak ribbit hu vechol avak ribbit enah asura ella middivrehem uvenichse yetomim lo gazru:
Mishneh Torah, Creditor and Debtor 5:
Haakkum veger toshav loyn mehen umalvin otan beribbit shenneemar <small>(Devarim 23 20)</small> "lo tashshich leachicha" leachich asur velishar haolam muttar. umitzvat ase lehashshich leakkum shenneemar <small>(Devarim 23 21)</small> "lannachri tashshich" mippi hashshemua lamdu shezzo mitzvat ase vezehu din tora: 
Asru chachamim sheyyihye yisrael malve et haakkum beribbit ketzutza ella bichde chayyav. gazru shemma yilmod mimmaasav berov yeshivato immo. lefichach muttar lilvot min haakkum beribbit shehare hu boreach millefanav veeno ragil etzlo. vetalmid chacham sheeno ragil bo lilmod mimmaasav muttar lehalevot laakkum beribbit afillu lehareviach. vechol avak ribbit im haakkum mutteret lakkol: 
Yisrael shellava maot min haakkum beribbit uvikkesh lehacheziram lo. metzao yisrael acher veamar lo tenem li vaani maale lecha kederech sheatta maale laakkum. hare zo ribbit ketzutza afillu heemido etzel haakkum ad sheyyittol haakkum meotav veyachzor veyittenem beyad yisrael haacher: 
Akkum shellava maot miyyisrael beribbit uvikkesh lehacheziram lo. metzao yisrael acher veamar lo tenem li vaani maale lecha kederech sheatta maale leyisrael hare ze muttar. veim heemido etzel yisrael af al pi shennatan haakkum hammaot beyado hoil umiddaat yisrael natan hare zo ribbit ketzutza: 
Asur leyisrael litlot meotav beyad akkum kede lehalevotan beribbit leyisrael. veakkum shehilva et yisrael beribbit asur leyisrael acher lihyot lo arev shekkevan shebbedinehem shettovea hearev techilla nimtza hearev tovea et yisrael beribbit shehearev chayyav bah laakkum. lefichach im kibbel alav haakkum shello yitba et hearev techilla hare ze muttar: 
Yisrael shellava maot min haakkum beribbit uzekafan alav bemilve venitgayyer im ad shello nitgayyer zekafan alav bemilve gove et hakkeren veharibbit veim mishshennitgayyer zekafan alav bemilve gove et hakkeren velo et haribbit. aval akkum shellava miyyisrael beribbit vezakaf alav et haribbit bemilve af al pi shezzekafan alav acher shennitgayyer gove et hakkeren veet haribbit shello yomru bishvil meotav nitgayyer ze. vegove hayyisrael mimmennu achar shennitgayyer kol meot haribbit shennitchayyev bahen keshehaya akkum: 
Mitzva lehakedim halevaat yisrael bechinnam lehalevaat akkum beribbit: 
Asur leadam sheyyitten meotav karov lesachar verachok lehefsed shezze avak ribbit hu vehaose chen nikra rasha. veim natan cholkin bassachar uvahefsed kedin haesek. vehannoten meotav karov lehefsed verachok lesachar hare ze nikra chasid: 
En moshivin chenvani lemachatzit sachar velo yitten maot likkach bahen perot lemachatzit sachar velo betzim lehoshiv tachat hattarnegolin shello lemachatzit sachar veen shamin agalim useyachin lefatteman lemachatzit sachar ella im ken natan lo sechar amalo umezono. o yihye revach hammitassek yoter al hefsedo kemo shebbearnu beinyan hashshuttafut: 
Hammishtattef im chavero bemaot o bekarka o hannoten lo esek lo yetzaref hassachar im hakkeren shemma lo yihye sham sachar venimtzeu bain lide ribbit. vechen lo yitten lo maot betorat esek o shuttafut veyichtov otan milve shemma yamut venimtza hashshetar beyad hayyoresh vegove bo et haribbit: 
Asur lehakedim haribbit o leacher oto. ketzad. natan enav lilvot mimmennu vehaya meshalleach lo sivlonot bishvil sheyyalvehu zo hi ribbit mukdemet. lava mimmennu vehechzir lo meotav vehaya meshalleach lo sivlonot bishvil meotav shehayu betelin etzlo zo hi ribbit meucheret. veim avar veose chen hare ze avak ribbit: 
Mi shellava mechavero velo haya ragil mikkodem lehakedim lo shalom asur lehakedim lo shalom. veen tzarich lomar sheyyekalleso bidvarim o yashkim lefitcho shenneemar <small>(Devarim 23 20)</small> "neshech kol davar" afillu devarim asurim. vechen asur lo lelammed et hammalve mikra o gemara kol zeman shemmeotav beyado im lo haya ragil baze mikkodem shenneemar neshech kol davar: 
Hammalve et chavero lo yomar lo da im ba ish peloni mimmakom peloni (kelomar) shettechabbedo vetaachilo vetashkehu karauy. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Yesh devarim shehen kemo ribbit umuttarin ketzad. lokeach adam shitrotav shel chavero befachot veeno choshesh. umuttar leadam litten lachavero dinar kede sheyyalve lifloni mea dinarin shello asra tora ella ribbit habbaa min hallo lammalve. vechen omer adam lachavero he lecha dinar ze veemor lifloni sheyyalveni. shello natan ella sechar amira: 
Yesh devarim shehen muttarin veasur laasotan mippene haaramat ribbit. ketzad. amar lo haleveni mane amar lo mane en li chittim yesh li bemane venatan lo chittim bemane vechazar ulekachan mimmennu betishim hare ze muttar. aval asaruhu mippene haaramat ribbit shehare natan lo tishim velokeach mane. veim avar veasa kaze hare hu motzi mimmennu mea bedin sheafillu avak ribbit en kan. vechen mi shehayta sade memushkenet beyado lo yachzor veyaskir otah levaal hassade mippene haaramat ribbit shehare ze omed besadehu keshehaya venoten laze sachar bechol chodesh bishvil meotav shehilvahu: 
Asur lehasekir haddinarin sheen ze dome lemaskir et hakkeli shehakkeli chozer beatzmo veze motzi ellu umevi dinarin acherot venimtza ze avak ribbit: 
Melech shehayu dinav shekkol mi sheyyitten hammas hakkatzuv al kol ish veish al yede ze shello natan yishtabed bo venatan al yado dinar af al pi shemmeshabed bo yeter middinar hare ze muttar. vechen kol kayyotze baze:
Mishneh Torah, Creditor and Debtor 6:
Hammalve et chavero sela bachamishsha dinarim o satayim chittim beshalosh o sela besela usea o shalosh sein beshalosh sein vedinar kelalo shel davar kol halevaa betosefet kol shehu hare zo ribbit shel tora veyotza bedayyanin. vechen hammalve et chavero vehitna immo sheyyadur bachatzero chinnam ad sheyyachzir lo halevaato. o shessachar mimmennu befachot vekatzav haddavar sheppochet lo min hassachar ad sheyyachzir lo halevaato. o shemmishken beyado makom shepperotav metzuyin beet hahalvaa kegon shemmishken chatzero al menat sheyyadur bo bechinnam. hare zo ribbit shel tora veyotza bedayyanin. vechen hammocher sade o chatzer beasmachta hoil velo kana hagguf hare kol happerot sheachal ribbit umachazir otan. vehu haddin lechol mi [shello] kana kinyan gamur mittechilla shehu machzir et happerot mippene sheim achal et happerot hare zo ribbit shel tora. vechol davar shehu asur mishshum ribbit chutz meellu hare hu asur middivrehem gezera shemma yavo leribbit shel tora. vehu hannikra avak ribbit veeno yotze bedayyanin: 
Hammalve et chavero lo yimshoch et avdo kede sheyyaase bo melacha af al pi shehaeved yoshev uvatel. velo yadur bachatzero bechinnam af al pi sheen hechatzer asuya lesachar veen derech baal hechatzer lehasekir. veim dar tzarich lehaalot lo sachar. veim lo heela lo hare ze avak ribbit lefi shello hitna immo sheyyalvehu veyadur bachatzero. lefichach im adayin lo hechzir lo chovo uva lenakkot sechar hechatzer sheddar bah min hachov im haya hassachar keneged hachov eno menakke lo hakkol ella kemo sheyyiru haddayyanim. sheim tesallek oto belo kelum hare ze kemo shehotzi oto bedayyanin vaavak ribbit enah yotza bedayyanin: 
Horu rabbotay shehammalve et chavero uleachar zeman tava chovo veamar lo hallo dur bachatzeri ad sheachzir lecha chovcha hare ze avak ribbit lefi shello katzatz bishat halevaa shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 37)</small> "lo titten lo beneshech": 
Hammalve et chavero al hassade veamar lo im lo tachzir li mikkan ad shalosh shanim hare hi shelli hare ze lo kana mippene shehi asmachta. lefichach menakke kol happerot sheachal mippene shehu ribbit shel tora. aval im amar lo hammocher im lo achzir lecha ad shalosh shanim kene otah meachshav vehevi lo betoch shalosh en lo perot. hevi lo leachar shalosh hare kol happerot lallokeach: 
Hammocher bayit o sade veamar hammocher lallokeach lichsheyyihyu li maot tachzir li karkai lo kana vechol happerot sheachal ribbit ketzutza umotziin otam bedayyanin. aval im amar lo hallokeach middato kesheyyihyu lecha maot ani achzir lecha karka ze muttar vehallokeach ochel perot ad sheyyachzir lo meotav: 
Machar lo et hassade venatan lo miktzat haddamim im amar lo hammocher lallokeach kene keshiur meotecha kol echad mishshenehem ochel perot keshiur meotav. amar hammocher lallokeach lichshettavi shear hammaot tikne meachshav shenehem asurim leechol happerot miyyad. hammocher asur shemma yavi hallokeach shear hammaot venimtzet hassade shello venimtza hammocher ochel perot bishvil hammaot shennisharu lo etzel hallokeach vechen hallokeach asur shemma lo yavi venimtza sheachal bishvil miktzat hammaot sheyyesh lo etzel hammocher. lefichach mannichin et happerot al yede shalish ad sheyyinnatnu leechad mehen. amar lo hammocher lichshettavi shear hammaot tikne hare hammocher ochel perot ad sheyyavi hallokeach veim achal hallokeach motziin mimmennu. amar lo hammocher kene meachshav ushear hammaot hare hen chov etzlecha hare hallokeach ochel perot veim achal hammocher motziin mimmennu kol ma sheachal: 
Horu rabbotay shehammalve et chavero umishken lo sadehu al menat sheyyochal peroteha kol yeme hammashkona af al pi sheeno menakke lo kelum hare zo avak ribbit veenah yotza bedayyanin sheen hamemashken et hassade dome limmashken bayit shehare en bassade perot metzuyin beet hahalvaa veefshar sheyyarviach veyihyu sham perot veefshar sheyyafsid bizriatah vaavodatah ulefichach hi avak ribbit. vechen en hammashkona doma lemi shemmachar beasmachta shehammocher beasmachta lo gamar vehiknahu vehamemashken gamar vehiknahu guf ze leferotav. vechaze yerae min haggemara. shehammashkona avak ribbit veen lecha lehaamidah ella bimmashken sadehu kemo shehoru rabbotay. nimtzeta lamed sheshshalosh mashkonot hen. mashkona shehi ribbit ketzutza. umashkona shehi avak ribbit. umashkona shehi mutteret. ketzad. mishken lo makom shepperotav metzuyin tadir kegon chatzer o merchatz o chanut veachal perotehen hare zo ribbit ketzutza. mishken lo sade vechayyotze bah uvau sham perot vaachalan hare zo avak ribbit. vechen im mishken chatzero vechayyotze bah benikkuy hare ze avak ribbit. mishken sadehu benikkuy hare ze muttar. ketzad hu hannikkuy. kegon shehilvahu mea dinarin umishken lo bahen chatzero o sadehu veamar lo hammalve hareni menakke lecha maa kesef bechol shana bischar karka zo kede sheyyihyu kol perotav shelli bechatzer vechayyotze bah asur uvesade vechayyotze bah muttar: 
Horu miktzat geonim shekkol mashkona sheen bah nikkuy kelal hare hi ribbit ketzutza. velo yardu leomek haddavar lehaferish ben sade lechatzer ulefichach nitkashshu lahen divre chachme haggemara. vechen horu shekkol mashkona afillu benikkuy asur ben bechatzer ben besade veen lahem mashkona mutteret ella badderech hazzot. ketzad. kegon shehilvahu mea dinarin umishken lo bahen bayit o sade vehitna immo sheachar eser shanim tachzor karka zo livaleha chinnam hare ze muttar leechol peroteha kol eser shanim afillu haya secharah shave elef dinarim bechol shana sheen ze ella kemi shessachar befachot. vechen im hitna baal hassade immo kol zeman sheyyavi lo maot yechashev lo eser bechol shana visalleko mimmenna hare ze muttar. vechen im hitna hallo shekkol zeman sheyyirtze mechashshev lo ma sheddar bo veyachzir lo shear haddamim veyistallek hare ze muttar sheen ze ella kischirut vechol tenay shebbischirut muttar kemo shebbearnu:
Mishneh Torah, Creditor and Debtor 7: Hammalve et chavero umishken lo et hassade ad zeman katzuv o ad sheyyavi lo maot veyistallek vehaya hammalve ochel kol peroteha afillu achal keshiur chovo en mesallekin oto belo kelum sheim tesallek oto belo maot hare ze kemi shehotzi mimmennu bedayyanin. veen tzarich lomar sheim achal yeter al meotav en motziin mimmennu. vechen en mechashshevin mishshetar lishtar bemashkona. hayta hakkarka hamemushkenet beyado shel yetomim veachal shiur chovo mesallekin oto belo kelum. aval yeter al chovo en motziin mimmennu hayyeter. umechashshevin lo mishshetar lishtar. ketzad mechashshevin mishshetar lishtar. hare shehayta sade zo memushkenet lo bemea dinar vesade acheret memushkenet lo bishtar acher bemea dinar ushete hassadot leadam echad veachal mipperot hassade haachat bachamishshim umipperot hashsheniyya bemea vachamishshim omrim lo hare achalta min happerot bematayim veen lecha kelum ucheillu hashshene shetarot shetar echad umashkona achat:

Makom shennahagu lesallek hammalve kol zeman sheyyavi lo maot hare ze kemo shepperesh veen tzarich lefaresh davar ze. vechen makom shennahagu shello yistallek hammalve ad sof zeman hammashkona hare ze kemo shepperesh. vechol hamemashken setam eno yachol lesalleko ad shenem asar chodesh:

Makom sheddarkan lesallek hammalve kol zeman sheyyirtze hallo vehitna immo hammalve shello yistallek ad sof zeman hammashkona hare ze eno yachol lesalleko. haya hamminhag sheen hammalve mistallek ad sof zemanno vekibbel hammalve alav sheyyistallek bechol et sheyyavi lo meotav hare ze tzarich liknot miyyado al kach:

Hammashkona bemakom shemminhagam lesallek hammalve bechol et sheyyavi meotav en baal chov shel malve gove mimmenna kederech sheggove min hakkarka. veen habbechor notel bah pi shenayim. usheviit meshammattah. ucheshemmesallek oto eno notel afillu perot shebbashlu venaflu laaretz. veim higbiah otan kodem sheyyesalleku kana otan. umakom sheeno yachol lesalleko ad sof zemanno baal chov gove hemennu. vehabbechor notel pi shenayim. veen hashsheviit meshammatta:

Af al pi shemmashkona zo asura hi vaavak ribbit kemo shebbearnu. efshar sheyyihye minhag ze betaut o laakkum o derech kol mi shechote umishken beotah medina hoil vaavak ribbit holchin achar hamminhag. veyesh mi shehora shezzot hammashkona benikkuy:

Akkum shemmishken chatzero leyisrael vechazar haakkum umecharah leyisrael acher en hamemashken chayyav lehaalot sachar leyisrael meet shekkana hayyisrael ella dar bechatzer belo sachar ad sheyyachzir lo haakkum et hammaot sheyyesh lo al chatzer zo shehare hu birshut hamemashken bedinehem ad sheyyitten lo meotav veyistallek:

Hamemashken bayit o sade beyad chavero vehaya baal hakkarka ochel peroteha veamar lo hammalve lichshettimkor karka zo lo timkerenna ella li bedamim ellu hare ze asur. veim amar lo al timkerenna ella li beshavyah veal menat ken ani malve otcha hare ze muttar:

Muttar leharebot bischar hakkarka. ketzad. hiskir lo et hechatzer veamar lo im meachshav atta noten li hare hi lecha beeser selaim bechol shana. veim titten sechar chodesh bechodesh hare hi besela bechol chodesh. hare ze muttar:

Hammaskir sade lachavero baasara korim leshana. veamar lo ten li matayim zuz sheafarnes bahen et hassade vaani etten lecha shenem asar kor bechol shana. hare ze muttar mippene sheim yefarnes et hassade bedinarin ellu yihye secharah yoter. vechen im hiskir lo chanut o sefina baasara dinarin beshana veamar lo ten li matayim zuz sheevne bahen chanut vaatzayyerenna vaachayyerenna o atakken bahen sefina zo uchele tashmisheha vaani aale lecha shenem asar dinar bechol shana hare ze muttar. aval im amar lo ten li matayim zuz kede lehitassek bahen bachanut o otziem bischora shel sefina o eskor bahen mallachin vaani aale lecha besachar hare ze asur:
Asur leharebot bischar haadam. ketzad. lo yomar lo ase immi hayyom melacha zo shehi shava kesef vaani eese immecha beshavua acher melacha shehi shava shetayim:

Muttar laadam lomar lachavero nakkesh immi hayyom vaanakkesh immecha lemachar ador immi hayyom veeedor immecha lemachar. aval lo yomar lo nakkesh immi veeedor immecha ador immi vaanakkesh immecha. kol yeme garid echad vechol yeme revia achat. velo yomar lo charosh immi begarid vaani echerosh immecha birvia. shehare torach hacharisha bimot haggeshamim yater. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Hassocher et happoel bime hachoref laasot immo bime hakkor bedinar bechol yom venatan lo hassachar vahare secharo shave bime hachoref sela bechol yom hare ze asur mippene shennire kemalve oto hayyom kede sheyyozil lo bischaro. aval im amar lo ase immi mehayyom vead zeman peloni bedinar bechol yom af al pi sheshshave secharo sela bechol yom hare ze muttar hoil vehu matchil laasot meatta eno nire kenotel sechar meotav shehikdim unetanan lo bischaro:
Mishneh Torah, Creditor and Debtor 8:
Asur leharebot al hammecher. ketzad. hammocher lachavero karka o mittaltelin veamar lo im meachshav titten li haddamim hare hen shellecha bemea veim ad zeman peloni hare hem shellecha beesrim umea. hare ze avak ribbit shezze dome kemi shennotel esrim bishvil shennatan lo mea lehishtammesh bah ad zeman peloni uchesheyyitbaennu baddin eno chayyav litten ella ma shehaya shave bishat hammecher o yachzir mimkaro miyyado im haya kayyam. vechen im machar lo mittaltelin ad zeman peloni bemea vehayu shavin bashshuk lemi shekkone bimotav miyyad tishim hare ze asur. veeno noten lo ella tishim o machzir miyyado sechorato im hayta kayyemet: 
Hallokeach mechavero chefetz beshavehu al menat sheyyitten lo mikkan vead shenem asar chodesh. hare ze rashshay lomar lo ten [li] miyyad befachot veeno choshesh mishshum ribbit: 
Chavit shel yayin shehi shava atta dinar umecharah lo bishnayim ad hakkayitz al menat sheim teera bah takkala hare hi birshut hammocher ad sheyyimkerenna hallokeach hare ze muttar. sheim avda o nishbera eno meshallem kelum. veim lo matza lemachrah uleharviach bah haya lo lehachezirah labbealim. vechen im mecharah lo bishnayim veamar lo hayyater al shenayim yihye secharcha bishvil sheatta metappel lemachrah veim lo timtza lemachrah kemo shettirtze hachazirah li hare ze muttar. af al pi sheim avda o nigneva o hechmitza tihye birshut hallokeach: 
Hayu lo perot sheim yirtze lemachran bashshuk velikkach demehen miyyad mochran baasara. veim tava otan hallokeach liknotan veyitten hammaot miyyad yikne otan bishnem asar. hare ze muttar lemachran bishnem asar ad shenem asar chodesh. sheafillu hevi ze meotav atta bishnem asar haya kone otan. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Asur liknot peri happardes kodem sheyyiggamer veyitbashshel. mippene shezze shemmocher bezol atta beeser hu peri sheshshave esrim kesheyyiggamer. nimtzet hattosefet bishvil hahakkafa. aval im kana egel bezol vehaya etzel habbealim ad sheyyagdil hare ze muttar shehare im met o kachash birshut hallokeach hu vehakkachash vehammita davar matzuy tamid: 
Hannoten maot levaal hakkerem al hassarigim veal hazzemorot lichsheyyikkartu shehem beyoker vehu kone otan bezol ad sheyyivshu veyikkartu hare ze tzarich lehappech bahen keshehem mechubbarim shennimtza kekone ilan lizmorotav. veim lo hafach nimtzeu hammaot halevaa vehen lokchin bezol mippene hahakkafa veasur: 
Shomre hassadot shennotnin lahem chittim bischaran bezol min haggoren. kesheyyavou laggoren tzerichin lehitassek immahen bimlacha baggoren kede sheyyihyu hachittim haellu shennatlu besof zeman hassechirut. veim lo asu kach nimtzet hassechirut etzel habbealim kemilve veze shellakchu bezol mippene sheicharu secharan ad haggoren: 
Arisin shehayu baale hassadot mesallekin otan min hassade benisan venotnin lahem haarisin bechol zera chomer arba sein vehinniach ze arisin betoch sadehu ad iyyar venatal mehen shesh sein hare ze muttar veen sham ribbit: 
Hallokeach chittim arba sein besela vechen hashshaar venatan lo et hammaot ucheshebba ligbot et hachittim leachar zeman hosif lo bammidda venatan lo yeter. hare ze muttar shehare birtzono hosif lo veillu ratza lo hosif shehare lo haya sham tenay: 
Muttar leadam litten deme chavit shel yayin lachavero velomar lo im hechmitza mikkan ad yom peloni birshutecha aval im hozila o hokira hare hi shelli. shekkevan shekkibbel alav hazzol hare ze karov lesachar ulehefsed. vechen kol kayyotze baze. vechen muttar leadam liknot mechavero betishre mea kaddin shel yayin bedinar veeno notlan ad tevet. ucheshennotlan bodek umachazir hachometz velokeach hayyayin hattov. shello kana mimmennu ella yayin tov veellu shehechmitzu mittechilla hayu reuyin lehachemitz aval lo noda haddavar ad achar hazzeman: 
Makom shennahagu liskor hassefina velittol secharah veim nishbera shamin lo ma sheppachata umeshallem yeter al secharah hare ze muttar. vechen muttar lehasekir sir shel nechoshet vechayyotze bo venotel hassachar udeme ma sheppachat mimmishkalo. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
En mekabbelin tzon barzel miyyisrael mippene shehu avak ribbit. vechetzad hen tzon barzel. hare shehaya lo mea tzon vekibbelam mimmennu lehittappel bahen veyihyu haggizzot vehavveladot vehechalav laemtza lishlish o lirvia ad shana o ad shenatayim kemo shehitnu benehem veim metu hatztzon hare hamekabbel meshallem demehem hare ze asur shehare baal hatztzon karov lesachar verachok lehefsed. lefichach im kibbel alav baal hatztzon sheim hukeru o huzelu o im nitrefu hare hen birshuto hare ze muttar. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Hashsham para mechavero veamar lo im meta hare hi atta alay bishloshim dinarim vaani aale lecha sela bechol chodesh muttar lefi shello asaah mechayyim damim ella leachar mita: 
Maskeret ishsha lachavertah tarnegolet leshev al habbetzim bishne efrochim veen choshshin mishshum ribbit: 
Mi shehaya noshe bachavero arbaa dinarim shel ribbit venatan lo bahen chefetz sheshshave chamishsha keshemmotziin mimmennu motziin mimmennu chamishsha hoil uvetorat ribbit ba leyado. vechen im natan lo bahen kesut o keli motziin mimmennu et hakkeli atzmo veoto hakkesut atzmo. hiskir lo bahen makom sheshshave secharo shelosha dinarin keshemmotziin mimmennu motziin mimmennu arbaa shehare bearbaa sachar mimmennu makom ze shekkibbel alav:
Mishneh Torah, Creditor and Debtor 9:
En poskin al happerot ad sheyyetze hashshaar. yatza hashshaar poskin. af al pi sheen laze yesh laze. ketzad. haya hashshaar lachittim kavua lashshuk arba sein besela hare ze posek immo al mea sein venoten lo chamesh veesrim selaim. veim yitten lo mea sea shel chittim achar zeman beet sheyyihyu hachittim sea besela en baze ribbit kelal af al pi shello haya lammocher chittim kelal beet sheppasak. bamme devarim amurim beshello haya lo kelum meoto hammin beet sheppasak alav. aval im haya lammocher meoto hammin kelum af al pi sheadayin lo nigmera melachto hare ze muttar lifsok alav af al pi sheadayin lo yatza hashshaar. ketzad. haya hu techilla lakkotzrim hare ze posek al hachittim af al pi sheadayin hen gadish. ufosek al hayyayin mishsheyyivtzor haanavim veyittenem beavit veal hashshemen mishshennatan zetim bammaatan veal hassid mishsheyyeshakkeenna bakkivshan. vechen posek al kele cheres mishsheyyaase hayyotzer betzim shellahen. bamme devarim amurim beshehaya afaran lavan aval afaran shachor posek al hakkelim hannaasin mimmennu af al pi shello naasu mippene shehu matzuy lakkol veaf al pi sheen laze yesh laze. vechen posek immo al hazzevel kol yemot hashshana af al pi sheen lo zevel mippene shehu matzuy tamid: 
Kol davar shehu mechussar melacha achat o shetayim posek immo alav. haya mechussar shalosh melachot eno posek ella im ken yatza hashshaar shekkevan shehu mechussar shalosh melachot hare ze kemi sheen lo meoto hammin kelum uchemo lo ba laolam adayin. ketzad. gadish shehaya mechussar hannacha bashshemesh sheyyivash vedisha uzeriyya eno posek alav ella im ken yatza hashshaar. haya yavesh veeno mechussar ella disha uzeriyya posek alav. betzim shel yotzer shehayu mechussarin lefifa veyibbush veholacha lakkivshan userefa vehotzaa eno posek alehen. hayu yeveshin veenan mechussarin ella holacha lakkivshan userefa posek alehen. vehu sheyyihye derech hallokeach lehotzi oto min hakkivshan. aval im haya hammocher hu shemmotzi hare ellu mechussarin shalosh veeno posek alehen ad sheyyetze hashshaar. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Haholech lachalov et izzav veligzoz et rechelav velirdot et kavvarto umetzao chavero veamar lo ma sheizzay cholvot machur lecha ma sherchelay gozzot machur lecha ma shekkavvarti roda machur lecha hare ze muttar. aval amar lo ma sheizzay cholvot kach vechach machur lecha bechach vechach. ma sherchelay gozzot kach vechach machur lecha bechach vechach. ma shekkavvarti roda kach vechach machur lecha bechach vechach asur ella im ken pasak immo kashshaar shebbashshuk. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
En poskin al shaar shel ayarot mippene sheen hashshaar kavua ella al shaar shebbammedina. hayu hachittim hachadashot bammedina arba sein besela vishanot shalosh besela en poskin ad sheyyetze hashshaar lechadash velayyashan. hayu chittin shel lekutot arba sein besela veshel baal habbayit shalosh posek lallekutot keshaar lekutot velo yifsok levaal habbayit ad sheyyikba hashshaar levaal habbayit: 
Kevan shennikba hashshaar muttar lifsok al hashshaar haggavoah. ketzad. hayu hachittim nimkarot arba sein besela ufasak immo sheyyitten lo hachittim kashshaar hazzol im amdu achar ken eser sein besela noten lo eser sein kashshaar shehaya bashshuk shehare pasak immo beshaar gavoah. natan lo hammaot setam velo pasak immo bashshaar haggavoah vehuzelu noten kashshaar shehayu shavin keshennatan lo hammaot. umi shechazar mekabbel mi sheppara. bamme devarim amurim befosek al daat atzmo. aval im haya shaliach laacherim ben hammocher ben hallokeach eno notel ella kashshaar hazzol o machzir et haddamim veeno mekabbel mi sheppara beshaliach shehare hameshalleach omer letakken shelachticha velo leavvet kemo shebbearnu: 
Hayu hachittim nimkarot arba sein besela venatal et haddamim venatan lo chamesh besela im yesh lo chittim muttar. hayu lo chittim chov etzel acherim venatal hammaot ad sheyyigbe chittav veyitten lo asur shehare hen mechussarin geviyya ucheillu enam vahare ze kekovea lo zeman vehozil lo mippene shemmakkifo: 
Hayu hachittim bammedina arba sein besela uvakkefarim shesh bassela hare ze muttar litten sela letaggar kede sheyyavi shesh sein min hakkefar. vehu sheyyihyu birshut hallokeach. im avdu badderech o nignevu avdu lo. veadam chashuv asur laasot ze. vbmine sechora asur lechol adam lefi sheen mine sechora metzuyin keferot: 
Hachammarin shennichnesu lair vahare hachittim arba sein besela. hozilu umachru lemakkirehen o lesafsarehen chamesh besela bammaot shennatnu lahen techilla kesheyyikkansu lair ad sheyyiftechu sakkehen veyimkeru lechol adam hare ze muttar sheen ellu mochrin lahem bezol mippene shennatnu maot atta velo yikchu ella leachar zeman ella mippene shemmodiin lahem et hashshaar umesaadin otam: 
Hammolich perotav mimmakom lemakom metzao chavero veamar lo tenem li vaani aale lecha perot sheyyesh li (bemakom peloni) beoto makom. im yesh lo sham muttar veim lav asur. haya molich sechora mimmakom lemakom amar lo tenem li vaani aale lecha dameha kemo sheshshave beoto makom im hayta birshut hammocher ad shehiggia lesham muttar veim hayta birshut lokeach asur: 
Hannoten levaal hagginna deme asara kishshuin ellu deme asara avattichim ellu vahare hen ketannim vehitna immo sheyyittenem lo lichsheyyagdilu hare ze muttar shehare hu mannichan vehem gedelim mealehen veillu kitztzetzan atta keshehen ketannim lo hayu baim acherim tachtehen. vechen kol kayyotze baze middavar sheen bo hefsed velo chissaron al hammocher:
